notes.title: NOTICE: Planned Official Server Wipes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9be6fae4a51ab281c7061471f99fc64a1c4868f8.jpg[/img]

In the coming months we’ll be launching a huge update adding a ton of new content including [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1648756010482845465]spell crafting[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/3064002141547043119]farming[/url], cooking, [url=https://twitter.com/PlayCitadel/status/974703262808117248]a complete menu and HUD overhaul[/url], a full rebalance of player progression, and many more massive game-improving refinements and new features! We'll continue to share more information as the release of this mega content drop draws closer, so stay tuned for more details!
 
As part of this update – thanks in large part to the constant flow of feedback shared by the community – we're also planning to make some very significant changes to player progression, gameplay balance and world layout. From the layout of the Knowledge Tree to the costs of various crafting recipes, these changes will greatly alter the game's balance and pacing. They will be significant to such a degree that server wipes will be necessary to ensure a fair and level playing field going forward. Our current target for this update is early-to-mid July, though this window may change as we continue to push forward in development.
 
To ease this transition, and to ensure that we don’t alienate our existing, long-devoted Citadel player base, we will be taking steps to preserve our top 10 currently most active servers. Though they will still get the new balance and progression changes, all structures and player progress will be maintained. These servers will be relabeled as “Legacy” servers to ensure that new players understand that the players in this world have begun with a significant advantage, and that they should consider starting their adventure elsewhere.
 
[b]Based on their level of activity, the following servers will transition into “Legacy” status after the update:[/b]
[list][*]TheBrink(OfficialEurope)
[*]CitadelUSEast33
[*]CitadelEurope11
[*]Tokoree(OfficialUSEast)
[*]Elundriel(OfficialUSEast)
[*]Luminous(OfficialUSWest)
[*]ShadowCape(OfficialEurope)
[*]Akatore(OfficialEurope)
[*]CitadelEurope4
[*]CitadelEurope5[/list]

A side effect of maintaining these servers is that there are likely to be a handful of unexpected technical issues and edge cases unique to these anomalous worlds. A number of skills that once existed no longer do, and there may be some unanticipated side effects to player progress persisting from the old Knowledge Tree. Some parts of the world have been redesigned to accommodate new resource types, and an array of new “no-build zones” have been added to further prevent players from embedding their base under rocks and in the terrain. The new design of Citadel is simply too different from the current balance to truly ensure these servers will make a full, smooth transition. While we are still committed to providing support to our “Legacy” servers as best as we can, we hope you’ll understand that there may be some issues that we simply will not be able to fix on these grandfathered servers.
 
As a side note, we’d advise anyone on one of these eventual “Legacy” servers to move their bases away from the rock walls at the northernmost reaches of Ignus. We will be extending a large no-build barrier to prevent players from concealing their bases via exploits.
 
We're excited to push Citadel into the next chapter of its development with this big update, and can't wait to share it with the community in the coming weeks. Stay tuned for more information, and we'll see you in Ignus!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/b919d6cf6e0a96d1c213e078e2ca2085c56be504.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9c4961e5bab68c9a4dbf81a01994360e7d713bd8.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! Today’s patch is small, largely due to a long weekend and shortened work week here in Canada. While we did consider altogether skipping today’s patch, we decided to go ahead and share an additional fix we had ready for a few lingering instances of the “Decay Bug" still being reported by some players. 

Though most people noted an immediate improvement after last week’s patch, a few players were still finding that certain areas were showing some unexpected decay. Thanks to your feedback, we’re adding one more check to the decay system to hopefully further prevent this. With today’s patch, if a structure piece should be labeled as “abandoned” by the game, it will check all adjacent pieces to ensure that they are “abandoned” as well. If any of those pieces should not be abandoned, the game can safely assume that the piece in question is in fact owned by the same person, and will promptly correct the mistake. 

We suspect this change will clean up the last remaining “Decay Bug” issues. As always, we appreciate your patience and support as we work to eliminate this bug once and for all. Should this change not solve your problems, please do continue to share your reports in our Bug Reports sub-forum, as they have been instrumental in our on-going investigation.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 05/16/2018 - "Decay Bug" & Other Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1a1f5d65ac5ff5a6b0ec83f58f65304cae1df742.jpg[/img]

[h1]Decay Bug (Likely) Fixed[/h1]
With this update we’ve made a fix that should theoretically put an end to the dreaded “Decay Bug” once and for all! This bug was a particularly nasty one, and required some fairly extensive investigation to weed out. We want to thank you all for your patience and support during this process. Your feedback and reports were essential in finding the root of the problem and making the changes needed to prevent it going forward!

The long and short of the situation is that the game’s decay system was not checking all available avenues to detect whether a throne has ownership over certain structure pieces. We’ve made changes to fix this, and expect that the decay bug will no longer be an issue after today. 

Having said all that, this bug was very hard to identify and reproduce locally, so we can’t 100% confirm this as a definitive fix until we get it out to everyone. We will be monitoring the situation following this patch, so please let us know if you experience any inexplicable decay on your structures (especially on PVE servers). We want to thank you again for all your feedback and patience as we’ve worked tirelessly on taking care of this significant annoyance!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1ac9c34736cbf9df69a142d4978c961517a1b606.jpg[/img]

[h1]Many Other Fixes[/h1]
While the bulk of our effort this week was focused on finally nailing down the “Decay Bug,” we still have a handful of other pretty significant fixes to share. A number of optimizations have been made behind the scenes, including improvements to structure load times on populated servers and some general refinements to game performance. 

Some players noted feeling motion sickness due to a jerky camera motion that was introduced with last week’s UI changes. We understand that this can cause very real physical discomfort for some people, so we’ve made it a top priority to get this fixed for this week’s patch.

There are a handful of other smaller fixes included in this week’s patch, which we’ve listed in full below. Take a moment to look them over while you wait for the servers to come back up with the latest version of the game. We want to thank you again for the patience and support you demonstrated during our investigation of the “Decay Bug,” and we look forward to hearing your reports after you’ve had a chance to get your hands on the update!

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Decay bug (very likely) fixed – [b]Please let us know if you continue to encounter decay issues![/b]
[*]Fixed jerky third person camera motion in some menus
[*]Structure load times greatly improved
[*]General optimization improvements
[*]Fixed a bug preventing looting other players’ dead tames
[*]Fixed a bug causing bizarre boss door behavior
[*]Fixed a bug preventing the construction of trap doors in some situations[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 05/09/2018 - Tracking Down The "Decay Bug"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/826b39eedd301b008ce6c70ab30c4624345ce414.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tracking Down The “Decay Bug”[/h1]
Tracking down the source of the nefarious “decay bug,” as it has come to be known within the community, is a top priority for us here in the studio. Though our initial assumption was that this bug was related to our decay system, we are now under the impression that it may be related to the way our game loads the world. 

As part of this ongoing investigation, we’ve turned Structure Health Persistence off with this newest public build. This is a temporary measure that will help us refine our search and get a better idea of what the root issue might be. All structures will (for now) load up at full health on a server restart. This will allow us to better pinpoint where the unintended degradation is occurring.

If you experience any inexplicable degradation in structure health during the next week or so, please alert us on the forums and provide as much info as you can, including the server you’re playing on, coordinates of the affected area, and any screenshots you may be able to provide. With your help we’ll close in on this bug and make sure it becomes nothing more than a bad memory!

[h1]Quest Improvements[/h1]
We’ve taken all our quests and split them between multiple new daily quest givers in each starter town. This change will ensure that everyone has consistent access to quests, as each new quest giver will provide quests to a different level range. Each quest giver is marked on your map, so be sure to take a look if you’re having trouble locating these new NPCs.  We’ve made a few other small quest improvements, so be sure to check the full patch notes below!

[h1]A Selection of UI Fixes[/h1]
We’ve also got a number of fixes for a few common UI quirks. We’ve patched up a number of circumstances where menus could overlap and become non-functional. On top of that, we’ve fixed bug causing the death screen to not show your cause of death. Finally, the “type” column should now properly populate in the game’s server browser. Should you encounter any further UI oddities, please be sure to share them with us in the Bug Reports section on the Steam forums!

[h1]Much More[/h1]
We’re hard at work on our upcoming massive update including Spellcrafting, Farming, Cooking and an overall rebalance of the entire Citadel experience! In the meantime, we will continue to keep a solid flow of fixes and updates for the game as it currently is, and will provide more info on these bigger features as we get closer to launch.

As always, give the servers a chance to come back up with the latest version of the game and feel free to share any feedback or suggestions you may have with us on our Steam forums. We hope you enjoy these new improvements, and hope to see you in Ignus soon!
[LIST]
[*]Structure health is no longer persistent
[*]Fixed a bug causing the server “type” field to not populate in the browser
[*]Fixed bug with death screen not properly showing  cause of death
[*]Fixed a bug where the ESC menu could open over the taming menu
[*]Quest markers have been made smaller on the map
[*]Quests have been split up and divided among multiple quest givers in each town
[*]Mounted kills will now contribute to quest progress[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 05/02/2018 - Net Driver Improvements, More Quests & More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3d0c28ba65cf98ba2b690185a389b94679c0559b.gif[/img]

After skipping last week we're back at it again with another Citadel update. Today's patch is, again, largely focused on improving server performance and rising pings on populated servers, and to that end we have a pretty substantial enhancement! We also have some new quest content, some bug and exploit fixes, and an entirely new visual improvement to Mana Generators. Let's get to it!

[h1]Net Driver Improvements[/h1]
The netcode improvements continue! We’ve made a pretty significant upgrade to Citadel’s NetDriver, which should have a dramatic impact on pings on servers with higher populations. To put it simply, we’ve made optimizations to the way the client and server replicate the various items and objects in the world. 

Previously, the game would evaluate every replicated actor on a loop for every player on the server. With today’s update, the game now takes a box query around each player and only considers those actors for replication. TLDR: You should experience much less of a rise in pings as more players join a server and interact with the world!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/df7f926eac4d67c53036d30848789497902cebc5.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Magic Structure Visual Improvements[/h1]
Remember how we changed Mana Generator lines to reduce the clutter? Forget all that! We’ve hunkered down and implemented a significantly better way of visualizing what’s powered-up and where it’s powered from, while also making the entire presentation much cleaner.

After this patch, Mana Generators will display a blue sphere of influence. Anything within its sphere can be powered by that Mana Generator. The best part is that these spheres will only be visible when you’re in build mode! Say bye bye to annoying lines and VFX clutter during normal gameplay forever!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/17de9889dec75f75ace52e8c463ae7fe2ff14f15.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Quests[/h1]
We’ve also added another 100+ daily quests to the selection offered by our daily quest givers, and a host of new quest givers have been added to the world. They will appear as exclamation marks on your map as you discover them, so be sure to explore the world and let us know what you think of the additional injection of quest variety!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5375038ca40f5490d8ebac876c3cda9d2cec066a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Much More[/h1]
As always, there are a handful of very nice bug fixes and gameplay improvements included in today's patch notes, so be sure to look below to see all the details. We hope you enjoy these new optimizations and fresh content, and hope to see you in Ignus soon!
[list][*]Significant Net Driver improvements
[*]Mana Generator visualization changes
[*]Added 100+ new quests
[*]Multiple new quest givers added
[*]Fixed an exploit allowing players to Blink through walls
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented players from building while mounted
[*]Various crash fixes[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 04/18/2018 - Tame Fast Travel
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/12af5605b57408daf38cb0107e2fa19f4af49cc8.jpg[/img]

It’s Wednesday, which means it’s time for another patch! Last week we put out a major patch featuring a big pass on structure optimization as well as a brand new feature: Quests. Our current implementation of Quests represents an early iteration of the feature, which will be expanded over time as we continue development. Please feel free to continue sharing your feedback and suggestions on this new feature for use in future refinements!

[h1]Tame Fast Travel[/h1]
When the topic of Ignus’ Fast Travel towers comes up, one of the key pieces of feedback we’ve heard is that players wish they could easily bring their tames with them. Historically, players would have to wait for their tames to catch up to them, which could take a significant amount of time depending on the speed and mobility of the mount, as well as the distance they’ve traveled across Ignus.

We’re happy to say that we’re putting an end to this annoying struggle with today’s update: Now you can interact with a Fast Travel portal while mounted! Doing so will spit you out at your destination, still mounted and ready to continue your quest without delay. Give it a try. Your Dragons will thank you!

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
Though this week’s patch is a little smaller coming off last week’s bigger patch, we still wanted to push out a few fixes and improvements to the overall Citadel experience. A few lingering annoyances have been resolved, and we’ve made a couple key quality of life improvements. Take a look below for the full list. As always, give the servers some time to come back online, and share your feedback with us on the  Steam forum, on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayCitadel]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/playcitadelgame]Facebook[/url]! 
[list][*]Can now use Fast Travel portals while mounted
[*]Fixed a bug preventing interaction while mounted
[*]Fixed server crashes related to Magic Structures
[*]Fixed a bug causing the game to switch to Fullscreen when clicking Accept in Video Settings
[*]Fixed the death screen not showing the name of your killer
[*]Improved appearance of some Magic Structures when unpowered [/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 04/13/2018 - Major Structure Optimization & Quest NPCs
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5375038ca40f5490d8ebac876c3cda9d2cec066a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Structure Streaming Optimization[/h1]
Today’s optimizations focus on the performance of Magic Structures, especially for castles and fortresses densely populated with crafting tables, transmuters, turrets and other functional constructs. Following this patch, players with a large number of these types of buildables should notice a significant increase in performance when in the vicinity of their home. We really look forward to hearing back from some of the players with enormous structures, so share your impressions on the forums!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1a6dd0c6aa197fe3744b78334fb8f3ae4efe6027.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quests Have Arrived![/h1]
Since the launch of Citadel last year, Quests have been one of the most frequently requested additions on the forums and social media by the community. With the release of today’s update, we’re happy to announce that Quests are now live and in-game! You will be able to find new quest givers in each of the three starter zones (Heathclyffe, Raincourt and Eastreach). These new NPCs will have a new quest available every day, so be sure to check them out regularly!

If you’re a max level player, we also have advanced quest givers stationed outside the three Boss Dungeon mausoleums. The quests given by these NPCs are significantly more challenging than the start town quests, but are designed to reward level 60 players with the most valuable resources relevant to them. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/b6b3bc5e18864a637fc1a293eaf2e9f54e285f86.jpg[/img]

This is an early implementation of our quest system, and we have bigger plans to expand it in the future. We sincerely look forward to hearing your feedback on this new feature, so definitely share your feelings on our forum after it has launched! 

[h1]Mana Link Visual Improvements[/h1]
We’ve also made improvements to the visuals of Mana Generators and the links they make to Magic Structures. As many of you know, historically a Mana Generator would draw a line to ALL Magic Structures within its area of influence. For bigger structures this has resulted in enormous webs of blue lines shooting off in seemingly every possible direction. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/95bfe9200323ce3b0d925c48881fe9c5eed6feba.jpg[/img]

These blue lines will now only draw between a Mana Structure and the nearest charged Mana Generator. With this set up, you will always know which structures are powered without the visual clutter of lines zipping all over your base!

[h1]Much More[/h1]
We also have a number of other fixes to share this week, including a fix for the cloth simulation on our capes and robes and fix to prevent further building of thrones and magic structures under the water. Check  out the full patch list below to see everything coming with this week’s update.

As always give the servers a chance to come back up, and share your feedback with us on the forums! We greatly appreciate your support and patience as we continue to roll these updates out, and we can’t wait to see you enjoying our new Quest system!
[list][*]Daily Quest Givers added
[*]Major structure streaming optimizations
[*]Mana Generators no longer draw large amounts of blue lines
[*]Cloth simulation on robes and capes fixed
[*]Fireball performance signifincantly improved
[*]Can no longer build thrones and magic structures underwater[/list]

notes.title: Patch Preview - Daily Quests
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/adc1f4b54f8e60a626b394d378b39d3cdcd4cc95.jpg[/img]

It would seem we are no longer alone! Three mysterious individuals of inexplicable affluence have made the long and dangerous pilgrimage to Ignus. Wizards who are interested in earning some precious resources and a little extra experience should make a point of visiting them in the three starter towns. Each of the three quest-givers will have a new quest every day, so there should always be plenty to do!

[b]These new quest givers are coming to Citadel this Wednesday![/b] Let's learn a little more about how they work:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e5adf93c9aa20e6a1dade46c3d18c553d98b0ee1.jpg[/img]

If the exclamation mark above a quest giver’s head is lit up, it means they have a task for you! Interact with them to receive all the details: You’ll be able to see a brief description of their conundrum, the specifics of your quest’s goal and a breakdown of all the rewards you stand to receive upon completion. If you feel up to the challenge, simply hit “Accept” and you’re ready to get on your way!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e1d4c87d6d8304ba8a1b1180945f354749c18e90.jpg[/img]

After you’ve accepted a quest, the details will automatically be pinned to your HUD to allow easy tracking of your progress. You can have a total of three quests active simultaneously. Quests can be conveniently completed at your own pace while exploring the world and fighting enemies naturally. Once you’ve completed your quest the HUD will update and you’re ready to claim your prize! Head back to the quest giver and reap your rewards!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/b6b3bc5e18864a637fc1a293eaf2e9f54e285f86.jpg[/img]

On top of these three new starter town quest givers, there are also three other quest givers positioned outside the boss dungeon mausoleums. These quest givers will only talk to you if you’re level 60, but they also offer some incredibly valuable rewards. Expect precious building resources and a bounty of key shards!

This is an early implementation of our quest system, and we have bigger plans to expand it in the future. We sincerely look forward to hearing your feedback on this new feature for later updates, so definitely share your feelings on our forum after it has launched! Thanks again for all your feedback as we continue to refine Citadel through our Early Access run!

[h1]Livestream - Tuesday, April 10 @ 4PM EST[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/8cfc4e32580c5b40a6238f787cd15f1c093e4654.jpg[/img]

If you'd like an even better demo of this new feature, check us out live tomorrow, Tuesday April 10th! We'll show off the new quest system and answer you questions, so come prepared! Give us a follow over at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/playcitadel]Twitch[/url] to make sure you don't miss out!

This is an early implementation of our quest system, and we have bigger plans to expand it in the future. We sincerely look forward to hearing your feedback on this new feature for later updates, so definitely share your feelings on our forum after it has launched! Thanks again for all your feedback as we continue to refine Citadel through our Early Access run!

If you'd like an even better demo of this new feature, check us out live tomorrow, Tuesday April 10th! We'll show off the new quest system and answer you questions, so come prepared! Give us a follow over at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/playcitadel]Twitch[/url] to make sure you don't miss out!

notes.title: Coming Soon: Spell Crafting
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/eb4c2613133114fbb1fb4d80cd6c257fe89294e9.gif[/img]

For the last few months, we here at Blue Isle Studio have had our heads down working away at a major content update that should be coming in the next month or two (we’ll share a more specific date as soon as we can). This large update will introduce a number of new systems and will almost completely re-balance the flow of game progression. 

Previously, we’ve shared some early details of this update’s new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/3064002141547043119]Farming System[/url], but with today's preview post we’re putting the spotlight on [b]Spell Crafting[/b]. This system is a complete overhaul of our existing spell system, and allows players a ton of room for experimentation and customization in creating their own unique spells. Let’s get right into it!

[h1]Procure Powerful Essences[/h1]
One of the key ingredients in the upcoming spell crafting system is Magical Essence. These Essences, which can be found in a variety of elemental types, pulse with Ignus’ natural magic energy; with much training, experienced mages can harness this latent energy and use it to craft spells of fantastic and potentially devastating power. 

The spell resulting from your concoction will vary depending on which essence type you use. Using Fiery Essence, for example, will create fire-based spells like flame beams and grenades, while using Storm Essence will create electricity-based spells like lightning strikes and static bolts. There will be a total of seven essences to work with, so you should have plenty of room to get creative and experiment!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ffa4a0c66d0c7f1ff08b5584ae27acee1f3925ed.gif[/img]

[h1]Choose Your Weapon[/h1]
The type of weapon used in the spell crafting process can also have a significant impact on the nature of the resulting spell. Choosing between a Staff and a Sword can potentially mean the difference between your spell taking the form of a simple bolt or an AOE explosive.

To further encourage experimentation, our Knowledge Tree has also been reformatted to organize weapons into progressions of material quality rather than streams of weapon types. For example, you can learn the recipe for the Wand of the highest quality available to you (based on your level) without spending points on the recipes for all previous Wands. Our hope with this change is to provide further build flexibility and prevent players from feeling forced to focus on just one weapon.

[h1]Add Your Modifier Ingredients[/h1]
The final pieces of the puzzle are a new set of modifier ingredients that can be acquired through our also forthcoming [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/3064002141547043119]Farming System[/url] (we’ll share even more about this soon). These ingredients, when tossed into the mix, can provide a number of useful enhancements to your resulting spell. Mandrake, for example, will apply a Bleeding modifier to your spell while Snapdragon will increase its range. You can experiment by mixing and matching up to five of these reagents to produce some interesting results!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/25c39eae618c37192674e1f10072394dd35ed133.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mix It All Together![/h1]
Once you've gathered your ingredients the last step is to throw it all into the Spell Crafting menu, choose the type of spell you want to create (ex. AOE, Projectile, etc.) and see what comes out! You'll be able to create all kinds of amazing results, so it's worth experimenting with different item combinations and seeing what you get. This entirely new selection of spells will also have a completely new and gorgeous set of VFX, so expect to be dazzled!

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
We'll be sharing more about this massive update as the weeks leading up to this huge update roll by, so stay tuned! We want to thank you for your patience as we work hard on optimization and developing new content for the  game as we continue to work our way through the Early Access process. All information shared today is still subject to change as we continue our work, so feel free to share your thoughts and feedback on the forums and in the comments below!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 04/04/2018 - Major Engine Upgrade
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e9c7aeb4393e256bdfb90ebc69200392c88fb96e.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! Wednesday is once again upon us, and we’re back at it again with another weekly patch. Today we take another big stab at performance with a significant update to our client optimization and a big upgrade to our core engine. For a complete breakdown of how this big update will help improve the Citadel experience, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1649881367339473443]click here to check out this informative Dev Blog from Citadel’s Lead Programmer[/url].

[h1][b] Upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.19[/b][/h1]
We’ve made a significant enhancement to Citadel’s back-end with an upgrade from Unreal Engine 4.16 to Unreal Engine 4.19. Since UE 4.16 (thanks to the success of Fortnite) Epic has implemented a number of changes to the engine that will help significantly improve Citadel’s dedicated server and client performance. You can [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/blog/unreal-engine-improvements-for-fortnite-battle-royale]check out this blog post from Epic[/url] to see exactly what we’ve inherited from the most recent upgrades made to the engine.

[h1][b]Other Performance Improvements[/b][/h1]
We’ve also made a few additional enhancements in our code to further improve performance. This includes a change to an ‘Event Driven Loader’, which should help reduce load times, and a full client performance pass of environment assets. Terrain, trees, grass, rocks and other foliage props should render much faster, providing an overall smoother gameplay experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7fb42455030723fa8acd84b6293e49e6fcce7130.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Other Fixes[/b][/h1]
On top of this big effort to improve Citadel’s performance, we also found time to patch up a few nagging issues that you guys have reported in the last little while. This includes a bug causing projectiles to hit lower than indicated by the reticle, a bug that would create significant lag during population of the server browser, and a few sound related issues. Take a look below for the full details! As always, thanks for your support and on-going feedback as we continue to work hard on Citadel’s development. Please give the servers a moment to come back up with the latest version of the game, and we hope to see you in Ignus soon!
[list][*]Fixed fullscreen green flashing for some users with NVIDIA GPUs
[*]Spells should land exactly at the reticle position
[*]Reduced lag during population of the server browser
[*]AI melee accuracy has been improved
[*]Fixed a server crash involving behaviour trees
[*]Fixed a bug where the boss gates would play a sound too many times
[*]Fixed a bug where AI melee would stay active after cast
[*]Fixed perpetual knockback with the Stone Golem
[*]Client performance greatly improved
[*]Server performance greatly improved[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog: Upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.19
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f73ae1df7a1629dca821adec05a7954707dbc54a.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Weekly patches are returning tomorrow![/b] With Wednesday's patch, we're focused on upgrading the Citadel project from Unreal Engine 4.16 to 4.19. Players of Citadel should notice a number of performance and optimization improvements after the completion of this transition. 

To help shed a little light on this upgrade, I’ve enlisted our [b]Lead Programmer Brenden[/b] to share some insight into the improvements you can expect with tomorrow’s update. Enjoy![/i]

[h1]Upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.19[/h1]
In this week’s patch, we’ve upgraded Citadel to Unreal Engine 4.19. This iteration of the engine brings a number of dedicated server and client performance improvements from Fortnite into the Citadel experience. Here’s an article listing some of the improvements we’ve inherited with the upgrade: https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/blog/unreal-engine-improvements-for-fortnite-battle-royale

In addition to server performance, we’ve also improved load performance by switching our game over to an Event Driven Loader. This makes sure that assets don’t get loaded more than once while referencing dependencies. 

With this latest upgrade, we’ll be able to take advantage of the engine’s new rendering features such as volumetric fog and auto group load conversions.

This upgrade was especially challenging for our team because we had previously made a number of source code changes that fixed various engine bugs and enabled some of Citadel’s more ambitious features. 

We ended up having to take the new sourcecode upgrade and then re-integrate all of those source edits to create a more updated custom engine. A number of our UI elements relied on logic that has since changed from 4.15 and required refactor and regression. The ‘Event Driven Loader’ upgrade was particularly challenging because a number of our assets were loaded differently from the new system and had to be conformed in order for the game to properly boot up.

We’ve since done full client performance pass of environment assets. This means that terrain, trees, grass, rocks and other foliage props should render much faster than on previous builds of Citadel.

In addition to the above upgrade and improvements, we’ve fixed some other nagging issues:
[list]
[*]Spells should land exactly at the reticle position
[*]Reduced lag during population of the server browser
[*]Using the search bar should not give mismatches when unchecking the toggle
[*]AI melee accuracy has been improved
[*]Fixed a server crash involving behaviour trees
[*]Fixed a bug where the boss gates would play a sound too many times
[*]Fixed a bug where AI melee would stay active after cast
[*]Fixed perpetual knockback with the Stone Golem
[*]Client performance greatly improved
[*]Server performance greatly improved[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7bd9f056981bba1b40127ca5dfff40b3dcae52ff.jpg[/img]

[i]So there you have it: More performance upgrades will be coming to Citadel with tomorrow's patch! As always, we'll have complete details available tomorrow as the patch is released. Thanks again for your patience as we continue to work through Early Access and bring improvements to the game's performance. Your feedback has been a tremendous help![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 03/21/2018 - AI Spawning & Tame Desync Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1fe49d64db05ae7140d4932f9a3287b2899bb6d6.jpg[/img]

Hello, Wizards of Ignus: It’s Wednesday, and that means it’s time for a weekly patch! We’re back at it patching up some serious bugs, many of which were fixed with the help of your feedback and support. Let’s get right to it!

[h1][u]AI Navigation/ Reactivity After Server Startup[/u][/h1] 
Some players, especially those running Custom Games, have noticed that the world’s enemy AI would behave oddly in the moments following a server restart. While some encountered situations where it would take a long time for them to begin spawning, others found that the AI would not react at all for a good long while. These issues have been fixed, and you should now find enemy AI spawning and reacting very soon after a server is started! We’ve also made some noteworthy improvements to the way AI navigates the world!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/acf8a6b834484112eb2de6ef36ec9ff321404cbe.gif[/img]

[h1][u]Tame Desync and Attack Fixes[/u][/h1]
Tame desync has been a bit of a problem for some players, but we’re happy to report that we’ve got a fix in place for the issue with today’s patch. Many players were experiencing issues where their tame would appear for them to be in one place, when the server considered them to be somewhere completely difference. Your game should now much more reliably stay in sync with the server after today’s update!

Additionally, we’ve fixed a few other tame-related issues. For example, attacks launched from tames are now more reliable: a dragon’s fireball, for example, will now go exactly where your reticule is pointed when aimed!

[h1][u]Much More[/u][/h1]
Check out the patch notes below for the full details of what’s changed with today’s update! As always, we’ll be listening for your feedback, so please feel free to share on the forums. Make sure you give the servers a moment to come back up with the newest version of the game, and we hope to see you in Ignus!
[list][*]Fixed an issue causing Trap Doors to always remain abandoned
[*]Fixed an issue causing mounted dragon projectiles to not match the player’s reticle 
[*]Fixed an issue causing dragon projectile emission points/hitboxes to not rotate correctly
[*]Fixed an issue causing Red Carpet to clip through floors
[*]Fixed an issue preventing AI from spawning and being responsive for a while after a server restarts
[*]Large Dragon idle sounds are now much quieter
[*]Party member can no longer see your throne location on their compass/map
[*]Fixed spell effect locations for dragon large/massive[/list]

While some encountered situations where it would take a long time for them to begin spawning, others found that the AI would not react at all for a good long while. These issues have been fixed, and you should now find enemy AI spawning and reacting very soon after a server is started! We’ve also made some noteworthy improvements to the way AI navigates the world!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/acf8a6b834484112eb2de6ef36ec9ff321404cbe.gif[/img]

[h1][u]Tame Desync and Attack Fixes[/u][/h1]
Tame desync has been a bit of a problem for some players, but we’re happy to report that we’ve got a fix in place for the issue with today’s patch. Many players were experiencing issues where their tame would appear for them to be in one place, when the server considered them to be somewhere completely difference. Your game should now much more reliably stay in sync with the server after today’s update!

Additionally, we’ve fixed a few other tame-related issues. For example, attacks launched from tames are now more reliable: a dragon’s fireball, for example, will now go exactly where your reticule is pointed when aimed!

[h1][u]Much More[/u][/h1]
Check out the patch notes below for the full details of what’s changed with today’s update! As always, we’ll be listening for your feedback, so please feel free to share on the forums. Make sure you give the servers a moment to come back up with the newest version of the game, and we hope to see you in Ignus!
[list][*]Fixed an issue causing Trap Doors to always remain abandoned
[*]Fixed an issue causing mounted dragon projectiles to not match the player’s reticle 
[*]Fixed an issue causing dragon projectile emission points/hitboxes to not rotate correctly
[*]Fixed an issue causing Red Carpet to clip through floors
[*]Fixed an issue preventing AI from spawning and being responsive for a while after a server restarts
[*]Large Dragon idle sounds are now much quieter
[*]Party member can no longer see your throne location on their compass/map
[*]Fixed spell effect locations for dragon large/massive[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 03/14/2018 - Server Optimization and Texture Streaming Improvements
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d610d0dacdaf6c2eca423c7cd710083843d63e01.jpg[/img]

[h1][u]Server/Performance Optimizations[/u][/h1]
We’ve made an important change in the backend of the game that should make pings and general performance on populated servers significantly better going forward. Previous to this patch, many players noted that overall server performance was on a continuous downward trend the longer a server was up and running. We discovered that one of the key reasons for this particular issue is a memory leak related to enemy AI behavior. We've used this patch to clean up this leak to prevent unnecessary stress on servers over long periods of operation. Optimization continues to be a top focus for our programming team, so we really appreciate the consistent supply of feedback provided by the community in this regard.

[h1][u]Texture Streaming Improvements[/u][/h1]
For the last few months, you may have noticed that high quality textures have taken a long time to load in. With this patch, you should find texture streaming to be significantly improved! Clear, high quality textures will now load in much, much faster, making for a much more attractive gameplay experience.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d8ba01ac6f41864728f622fe83664d2b41a1672d.jpg[/img]

[h1][u]Much More[/u][/h1]
In addition to the visual improvements and performance optimizations, we’ve also cleaned up a number of pesky bugs that have been reported by the community. We’ve fixed the issue that caused Mana Generators and Acid Pools to display improperly after last week’s patch, continued the process of differentiating Parties from Houses, and have added a few refinements to the recently released Broomstick League game mode.

Check out the full list below, and continue to share your thoughts and feedback on [url=twitter.com/playcitadel]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/playcitadelgame]Facebook[/url] and in the discussion forums here on Steam.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Performance improvements due to fixed NPC memory leak
[*]Lighting improvements on some torch structures
[*]Fixed an issue with Mana Generator UI not displaying properly
[*]Fixed an issue with Acid Pool structures not displaying properly
[*]Party members can no longer use your respawn stone – only house members can
[*]Added control pop up at the start of a Broomstick League match
[*]Broomstick League ball performance improvements[/list]

notes.title: Broomstick League: Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ed3d5d90ac4447014fb6c352066d264a1144d40f.jpg[/img]

The roar of the crowd intensifies as you step through the gate and enter an arena surging with excitement and magic. Your pulse quickens as you take your position and stare down your opponents. This is the moment your House has been training for: Are you ready?
 
A new age of friendly competition has dawned on Ignus! Broomstick League, an ancient, high-flying aerial sport of fantastic proportions, is now available for Wizards of all disciplines and levels of experience. Demonstrate your gravity defying aerobatic skills as you whiz around a brand new stadium environment and score big points in a team of up to five players.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RusawcrRfSg
[h1]BRAND NEW GAMEPLAY MECHANICS[/h1]
New shooting and passing mechanics make executing fast plays completely effortless. Use exclusive Broomstick League spells to smash the ball out of your opponent’s hands, zip across the field in one quick burst of speed, and deflect the ball’s trajectory away from your net. Shots made into the large vertical net score a single point, while skillshots dunked into the smaller horizontal net will reward a whopping two points!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6a64172f3dc43d2a5eaed259c79f734f75128d1e.gif[/img]
 
[h1]ARENA MODE: ORGANIZED MATCH PLAY[/h1]
Seamlessly challenge friends and strangers alike to a game of intense sport! Portals have emerged in the three starter towns which will transport you to the official Broomstick League Stadium. Simply hop in and let the game take care of the rest! A message will be broadcast to the server, participants will automatically be equipped with the necessary equipment, and the game will completely organize a full game with a five minute timer.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/216ec452c623818fcb2ec4a1e193df26bf858943.gif[/img]
 
[h1]FREE BUILD: GET CREATIVE WITH NEW STRUCTURE PIECES[/h1]
Unlock structure recipes for the Broomstick League Ball Dispenser, Vertical Net and Horizontal Net. Let your imagination run wild and build absurd arenas, construct crazy contraptions and devise the ultimate setting for your own completely unique sports and games. Build a basketball court and practice your free-throws. Construct a golf course and invite your friends to beat your record. Fashion a make-shift, gigantic Pachinko board and place friendly bets. The tools are yours to explore and experiment with!
 
[h1]MUCH MORE[/h1]
This massive update also includes a number of gameplay tweaks, bug fixes and visual improvements. Combined with the content we’ve released since launch – new structure pieces and functionality, tons of new creatures, weapons, armors and items, new spells , server optimizations and new gameplay systems – Citadel is now the best it’s ever been!

notes.title: Broomstick League Preview: Free Build
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/216ec452c623818fcb2ec4a1e193df26bf858943.gif[/img]

The release of our Broomstick League update is just around the corner! The fast-paced action of this new competitive game mode zooms its way into Citadel on Wednesday, March 7th.

[h1]Build Arenas with New Structure Pieces[/h1]
While the update includes an entirely new, organized game mode – which you can learn more about from last week’s post – we’ve also made sure to keep this new content consistent with the sandbox creativity that makes Citadel’s building system so enjoyable. To that end, we’ve decided to make both the BSL Nets and the BSL Ball Dispensers available as learnable structure recipes, giving you the freedom to construct your own arenas.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0bb9e297df8530269994a7092e8039b1804989a3.png[/img]

The BSL Nets available come in two types: horizontal and vertical. Both come fully equipped with a built in score counter to keep track of the action. Any time a BSL Ball enters the score zone, the giant number display in the center will tick up one point. By interacting with the net, players will be able to reset the score to start a fresh count.

[h1]Get Creative![/h1]
In an effort to ensure that this update stays in-line with the spirit of Citadel's creative freedom, we've put no restrictions on how you use the above mentioned tools. Let your imagination run wild and build absurd arenas, construct crazy contraptions and devise the ultimate setting for your own completely unique sports and games. 

Want to enjoy a leisurely alternative to the breakneck, fast-paced action of standard BSL? Get building with the new structure pieces to create your very own Pachinko board! Take turns and place bets with your friends.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0dca034b1fd58de7f4b92f669123b2185a32847c.gif[/img]

Perhaps you'd be more interested in creating your own marble maze?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/8aaf75cb4152b2bbf04fe4d65b73bc2b7d87b04e.gif[/img]

How about golf???

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ed62f5af3b33e5ffad05fa41332d6e9587dfe7b1.gif[/img]

Find your own new and creative ways to make amazing structures and create your own games with these fantastic new structure pieces. The possibilities are limitless!

[h1]Developer Livestream - March 6th at 4PM ET[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0d00d0db21f64421b952fdd66cf86a232cd1f114.jpg[/img]

We'll be playing a little Broomstick League LIVE tomorrow! If you want to see the update in action, watch us build some crazy new structures, or ask us a question or two, be sure to stop by tomorrow at 4PM ET! You can find us at www.twitch.tv/PlayCitadel

notes.title: Broomstick League Preview: Arena Mode
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7a7709ec695755f83f67c1c4795fb25d0e03f311.gif[/img]

With the upcoming Broomstick League update [b]on March 7th[/b], we’ve decided to make the high-flying sports action available in two different ways. While you can unlock and build all the necessary items and structures in the game’s main sandbox – which is something we’ll talk about more soon – the update also provides you with a system of completely structured match play through Arena Mode.

[h1]How to Play[/h1]
After the update drops, simply head to one of the three starter towns to begin an Arena Mode game. Each starter town will now have a set of spiffy Broomstick League portals, all of which link up to the same arena. Simply hop through one of the portals to initiate a match! A message will be broadcast to the server, inviting them to join you in an Arena Mode game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9bd5a4dbca20ada733b01bf7ae48981d6b365161.gif[/img]

[h1]Match Structure[/h1]
Once you’ve entered Arena Mode the game takes care of everything! Teams will be automatically partied and organized into both Red and Blue teams. After a countdown timer allowing others a chance to jump in, the game will begin. Each round starts with a three second timer, after which players will be free to either retreat to defensive positions or rush to grab the ball in the center of the arena. 

When holding the ball, players can use left click to shoot and right click to pass another teammate. By holding left click, shots can be charged up for increased speed and distance. A shot in the opposing team’s main net scores a point, while dunking into the smaller horizontal net scores a cool two points. Games last the duration of a five minute timer, with brief pauses between goals.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6a64172f3dc43d2a5eaed259c79f734f75128d1e.gif[/img]

[h1]Spells & Items[/h1]
Additionally, all joining players will automatically be equipped with the necessary equipment, including a special Broomstick League wand, a set of Broomstick League spells, and a Broomstick League athletics broom. All flight is free during Arena Mode play, allowing unlimited aerobatic capability!

The new Broomstick League spells (which can only be accessed via Arena Mode) enhance your mobility and provide you with a means of offensive play. Blink, which binds to your right click, launches you forward quickly. It’s ideal for those intense, clutch moments where you need to race in to grab the ball or make a hasty retreat back to cover your net. Just be careful with how you cast it: cast it too liberally and you may find yourself stuck in cooldown when you need it most!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/20117b407e789e4a6aa0a9e207f8d7686dd2e781.gif[/img]

Arena contenders will also receive Mana Blast, which binds to the left mouse button. This offensive spell can be used to deflect an incoming ball or bash it out of the hands of an opposing aviator. Like Blink, Mana Blast has a bit of a cooldown, so try to exercise control and time your shots right!

As mentioned above, we also provide you with all the necessary tools to build your own arena and host informal matches in the main sandbox world! Stay tuned for more details on that as we move closer to our March 7th release date.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/84d9ba397f967dfb60e0645a5da8db9ca134e6db.gif[/img]

When holding the ball, players can use left click to shoot and right click to pass another teammate. By holding left click, shots can be charged up for increased speed and distance. A shot in the opposing team’s main net scores a point, while dunking into the smaller horizontal net scores a cool two points. Games last the duration of a five minute timer, with brief pauses between goals.

Additionally, all joining players will automatically be equipped with the necessary equipment, including a special Broomstick League wand, a set of Broomstick League spells, and a Broomstick League athletics broom. All flight is free during Arena Mode play, allowing unlimited aerobatic capability!

The new Broomstick League spells (which can only be accessed via Arena Mode) enhance your mobility and provide you with a means of offensive play. Blink, which binds to your right click, launches you forward quickly. It’s ideal for those intense, clutch moments where you need to race in to grab the ball or make a hasty retreat back to cover your net. Just be careful with how you cast it: cast it too liberally and you may find yourself stuck in cooldown when you need it most!

Arena contenders will also receive Mana Blast, which binds to the left mouse button. This offensive spell can be used to deflect an incoming ball or bash it out of the hands of an opposing aviator. Like Blink, Mana Blast has a bit of a cooldown, so try to exercise control and time your shots right!

As mentioned above, we also provide you with all the necessary tools to build your own arena and host informal matches in the main sandbox world! Stay tuned for more details on that as we move closer to our March 7th release date.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 02/21/2018 - AI Behaviour Fix & More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/2a67cb84f1bde717bb5011cfe148c5ca82b60b2d.jpg[/img]

[h1] AI Killing Each Other Fixed[/h1]
Since our last patch, a number of players have reported strange AI behavior. Specifically, some NPCs have been observed killing other NPCs that they normally wouldn’t, including same-type NPCS that should be considered allies. We’ve identified the source of this bug and have fixed it for today’s patch. NPCs will now only kill other NPCs where it makes sense (ie, Orcs will hunt Direwolves, etc.)

We’ve fixed a critical bug that caused crashes for users trying to create a new Custom Game without having a pre-existing world save. Now, new players should be able to easily and reliably start up a new Custom Game to play alone or with a friend.

[*]Fixed an issue that caused some resource nodes to not respawn properly
[*]Fixed a bug allowing players to hurt an offline housemate’s tames
[*]Fixed a bug preventing large doors and windows from being built on certain walls[/list]

[h1]No Patch Next Week/Big New Content Coming Soon[/h1]
The team has been very hard at work preparing the next major content drop, which should be coming very soon! In order to make sure everything is working perfectly for its launch, we will be taking a week off from weekly patches. Stay tuned, though, as we’ll be sharing a ton of details next week on Citadel’s next big thing!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 02/14/2018 - Additional Terrain Fixes & Party Permission Changes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3f352c19a74f39a70706d5097e84b8ec0d699294.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional Terrain Exploit Fixes[/h1]
Though we rolled out our glitched base removal patch with great success last week, a few players were still able to find some lingering areas where they could build between the earth and large rocks. Though not technically under the map, these bases are still invisible to players who are playing the game fairly and can only be accessed via exploitation of the game. 

We’ve taken additional steps to identify these areas and prevent players from accessing them in the future. If you should encounter any small pockets of rock that players have used to unfairly conceal their base, please share the info on the forums so we may continue to block them out. Screenshots and coordinates are always a help!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/a8930a8ef27250bdf079d85dc0e66da41d15e706.jpg[/img]

[h1]Party vs House Differentiation[/h1]
Today we make our first change in what will be the on-going process of differentiating and expanding the flexibility of the Party and House systems. As a result of a ton of player feedback, we’ve made a small change to the permissions granted to party members: After today’s patch, party members will no longer bestow full structure and storage access to all other players in their party. Party members will now only see each other marked on their maps, see each other’s vitals on the HUD and will not be able to harm each other via friendly fire.

This change is made to give a little bit more diversity in the types of collaborative relationships players can have. Previously, Party and House status were more or less identical. Now, players can feel free to join forces with other players they’ve only just met without granting them complete access to their chests/doors and allowing them permission to build upon or destroy their castles. 

[h1]Bonus Damage Fixed[/h1]
Expect to see a boost in the damage output of some of your higher tier weapons after today’s update! We’ve been tracking a bug that caused “Bonus Damage” stats on weapons to not function properly. For example, a wand with 25 Damage would perform exactly the same as a wand with 25 Damage and a +5 Bonus Damage modifier. Bonus Damage will now work properly as it was originally intended. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/bbd05a58e7e0d5676cc42bcb92f7db239a502fa1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Fixes[/h1]
We’ve also fixed a few smaller bugs that have been on our list for a little while. Large Curved Floors can now have magic structures and furniture placed on them without issue, Blue Aura has been fixed to properly cast with consistency, and we’ve fixed a few bugs that would cause some tames to become completely unresponsive. 

As always, our full patch notes are shared below. Give them a look and feel free to share your feedback here or on our Steam forums. We thank you again for your support as we refine the game through Early Access, and we hope to see you in Ignus soon!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Blocked areas where players could unfairly build structures behind rocks
[*]Removed building and structure access privileges from party members
[*]Fixed a bug causing the Bonus Damage stat to not properly apply
[*]Fixed a bug causing Blue Aura to frequently fail at being cast
[*]Fixed a bug that caused texture settings to incorrectly display as being set to High when actually on Low
[*]Fixed a bug preventing construction on parts Large Curved Floor pieces
[*]Fixed a bug granting full structure access to any player who parties with the first person to connect to a server
[*]Fixed a bug causing some tames to become stuck and unresponsive after an unexpected disconnection[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 02/07/2018 - Griefer Bases Removed
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/cad7c9e430a9a5313449b774c07a399975c1ce56.jpg[/img]

It’s Wednesday, which means it’s time once again to release another weekly patch! Today we bring you an offering of bug fixes, UI improvements and other goodies to continue our Early Access quest of refining the Citadel experience. 

As you may have seen from the various notices leading up to now, the primary focus of today’s update is to definitively end the practice of building glitched bases under the map and in caves blocking dungeons. These bases require the use of unsanctioned glitching to be built, and are often made by toxic players looking to gain an unfair advantage for the sake of griefing. For full details of what has changed you can read [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/2448137522013536605]this post[/url].

On top of this big change, we’ve also made a number of improvements and bug  fixes for today’s release: The server browser has been updated to filter out mismatched servers,  new keybindings have been added for the build menu to accommodate users without a scroll wheel, Lightning Storm has been fixed, and more. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/cd580282a6a1d2491f7ff9234e71c69acbddeac8.jpg[/img]

Check out the full list below for the full details, and as always give the servers some time to come back up with the latest version of the game. Please feel free to share your feedback of this update here or on the forums, and we hope to see you in Ignus soon!

[list][*][b]All bases under the map and in caves have been removed, and checks have been applied to prevent them from being built in the future[/b]
[*]Added filter option for mismatched servers to the server browser
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Lightning Storm to not cast with consistency
[*]Added keybinding options for the build menu
[*]Added support for the /fly, /flightspeed, /ghost, /togglemeshes and/cinecam[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 01/31/2018 - New Enemy: Giant Golem
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ef40c53dcfaa0d34a6cec7707ede80da9f50c8e7.gif[/img]

[h1]The Great Golem Has Arrived! [/h1]
This hulking goliath of animated stone and wood poses a major threat to any careless Wizards and Warriors who might disturb its indefinite slumber. A resting Giant Golem is capable of lying dormant for hundreds of years if left unbothered and can be near indistinguishable from the natural resources that litter Ignus’ terrain. Adventurers who find themselves invading a Great Golem’s personal space must make a quick choice between two options: Run like hell, or prepare for battle!

Great Golems are high level enemies who pack a serious punch at both a distance and up close. Players who wish to challenge these behemoths are advised to stock their inventories with healing items and bring their friends along for the battle. The battle will be intense, but the rewards are worth it: Great Golems drop a significant amount of valuable building resources including Stone, Precious Stone, Gold Ore and Light Essence.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f62b7b4497e628b5f50f50ecc17f7b23f7b84324.gif[/img]

[h1]The Return of Last Week’s Fixes[/h1]
In addition to the fixes added this week, we’re also reinstating the bulk of last week’s rolled back changes. Despite thorough testing, we found that one of the server optimizations we made in last week’s patch caused loading times to increase to unreasonable levels. That patch’s changes and fixes are now included in this week’s offering, though we’ve removed the server changes until we’re able to roll them out in a stable form.  Click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1646497873772087835]here[/url] for the original post (changes have also been included in today’s patch notes again for clarity).

[h1]Under Map/Glitched Base Removal Delay[/h1]
Due to a last minute snag, we will be postponing the automatic removal of bases built in caves and under the surface of the map until next week’s patch. Those of you who still have yet to move your base to a safe area should take this opportunity to do so before the implementation of this system next week. For more information about this change, see the relevant post [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/2448137522013536605]here[/url].

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Here’s the full list of changes from today’s patch! As mentioned above, the reinstated fixes from last week’s patch are also included in this list (as indicated):

[list][*]New enemy added: Giant Golem
[*]Fixed HUD display issues on 4K displays
[*]Can now rebind the Spellbook hotkey in the Keybinds menu
[*]Fixed an issue causing equipped armors and weapons to not be visible to other players
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug causing Tame information to get stuck on the HUD
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug causing some Thrones to never decay
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed a  bug causing Terrene Smash and other spells to shoot at a right angle rather than forward
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed the Safe Zone tame parking exploit
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug causing upgraded defense and offense towers to not display their updated model
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug with certain magic structure UIs to not follow the player
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug causing flight trinket VFX to not deactivate when not used
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Creatures can no longer be tamed while in Safe Zones
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b]
[*]Fixed an issue causing gloves to disappear when flying
[b](returning from last week’s rolled back patch)[/b] [/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 01/24/2018 - Tame Safe Zone Parking & More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/be9416acdc3b56e29b2abaf50f8b5522aa5c8cc9.jpg[/img]

Hello, Wizards of Ignus: It’s Wednesday, and that means it’s time for a weekly patch!

As indicated by yesterday’s notice, the goal of today’s patch is to once again stamp out another nasty player-reported exploit. This exploit is one that allowed players to keep tames completely safe for an indefinite period of time in Safe Zones. These tames could even be loaded up with precious items and resources to act as invincible storage points, which is not a functionality that was ever intended for the game. 

Starting today, tame loyalty will burn faster when a tame is parked in a starting zone. Initially, this heightened burn rate will be small, but will speed up the longer a tame remains in the safe zone, eventually reaching a point where tames will shed hours of loyalty in the span of seconds. Players who leave their tames in the Safe Zone and log off will almost certainly return to find they’ve gone wild and left them, making the strategy completely unviable for exploitation. (Please note, we do plan to add better options for safe-housing of tames in the future. Stay tuned for more info.)

As always, we also have a series of bug fixes to help further refine the Citadel gameplay experience. Many melee players noticed something strange with their spell loadout during the last week: when cast, Terrene Smash would shoot out completely sideways! While this was pretty funny to see, it was also very frustrating once the novelty wore off and it came time to slay some enemies. This has now been fixed.

As always, there are more bug fixes for you to look at in the complete notes below:

[list][*]Fixed an issue causing equipped armors and weapons to not be visible to other players
[*]Fixed a bug causing Tame information to get stuck on the HUD
[*]Fixed a bug causing some Thrones to never decay
[*]Fixed a  bug causing Terrene Smash and other spells to shoot at a right angle rather than forward
[*]Fixed the Safe Zone tame parking exploit
[*]Fixed a bug causing upgraded defense and offense towers to not display their updated model
[*]Fixed a bug with certain magic structure UIs to not follow the player
[*]Fixed a bug causing flight trinket VFX to not deactivate when not used
[*]Creatures can no longer be tamed while in Safe Zones
 [*]Fixed an issue causing gloves to disappear when flying[/list]

[h1]About Tame Desync[/h1]
We’ve heard many players report issues with tame desync. Players have described instances where a tamed creature may appear to be in one place for them and in a completely different place for other players

We’ve found that these issues actually stem from tames traveling within Safe Zones. To avoid having desync problems, we recommend players try not bringing their tames into the Safe Zones until our fix is completed and implemented. 

While we don’t have a solution to this problem in today’s patch, rest assured that we are working very hard to have one available for you very, very soon. Apologies for the wonkiness!

[h1]Next Week[/h1]
Next week is the long anticipated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/2448137522013536605]Cave and Undermap Base Removal update[/url]. If you still have structures in caves blocking chests or under the map [b]we strongly recommend you begin the process of rebuilding right now![/b] Any structure pieces remaining in caves or under the map after Wednesday [b]will automatically be removed[/b] without refund of resources.

It’s been a while since we expanded Citadel’s bestiary, but that all changes soon: Next week will also see the introduction of a new creature type to the world of Ignus! This towering behemoth is absolutely [b][u]massive[/u][/b] and is unlike anything else that currently exists in the game. Its defenses are near impenetrable and its damage output is devastating! Be ready for more details very soon!

notes.title: NOTICE: Safe Zone Tame Parking Exploit & Cave/Underground Building Reminder
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e39e9bb790d8e7b8ce40c09bd98dd2f1a90da21a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Safe Zone Tame Exploit Fix[/h1]
We’d just like to share a small heads up on a change that will be occurring with tomorrow’s patch. Many players have complained that other players have been abusing the game’s Safe Zones as a safe place to store dragons. These players will often load these dragons’ inventory up with precious resources, making these players invulnerable to losing their possessions via raids and other world threats.

Starting tomorrow, tame loyalty will burn faster when a tame is parked in a starting zone. Initially, this heightened burn rate will be small, but will speed up the longer a tame remains in the safe zone, eventually reaching a point where tames will shed hours of loyalty in the span of seconds. Players who leave their tames in the Safe Zone and log off will almost certainly return to find they’ve gone wild and left them, making the strategy completely unviable for exploitation.  With that in mind, we recommend you move any tames you currently have parked in Safe Zones as soon as possible before the patch hits.

[h1]Glitched Base/Cave Structure Removal[/h1]
Just another reminder that NEXT WEEK (not tomorrow) we'll be removing all structures built in caves and under the surface of the world to prevent griefing and further exploitation. Please start the process of moving your structure now to avoid lost resources and work. If you need further information, please feel free to add me on Steam and send me a private message.

[h1]Tomorrow's Patch[/h1]
Tomorrow’s patch will feature a number of additional fixes and improvements, including a fix to stop players from safely taming creatures in the Safe Zones, a fix to address issues with spells shooting sideways, and much more. Stay tuned for full patches as we approach release tomorrow afternoon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 01/17/2018 - Major Exploit and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3b42d6fd2d8b596541a4a93b6581e7baa703f13a.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards of Ignus!

Now that the holidays are over and we’ve all settled back into the routine of fixing bugs and balancing the game, we’ll be resuming our regular schedule of Wednesday patches. Today’s patch is focused on cleaning up some major bugs and removing one of the most frequently abused exploits. Let’s get right to it:

[h1]Exploit Fix: Using Dragons to Grief Structures[/h1]
This week’s biggest fix targets a major raiding exploit that a number of players have sent to us over the last few weeks. Before today’s update, it was possible to use enemy NPCs to raid another player’s base without Siege Spells. Griefers were able to agro high level dragons and manipule their AI to have them do significant damage to another player's structure. Toxic players have been using this exploit to easily destroy the hard work of other players, even on PVE servers.

While we do want monsters to be able to harm structures, we don’t want players to be able to exploit this for griefing purposes. Our solution involves two changes: First, enemies can only damage a structure if the owner is the same as the player it is currently agro’d on, which should prevent this exploit from working in the future. If you upset a Pyrant and run for shelter, it will still break in and come after you. On the other hand, if someone is baiting a dragon into shooting fireballs at your structure you will see no damage.

Secondly, we’re also fixing a bug that causes dragons to never drop their agro. This bug made it very, very easy for a player to drag a dragon extreme distances, as they’d never give up their hunt. Now, dragons will behave like all other monsters and eventually give up fighting you after a certain amount of time has passed.

[h1]Bug Fix: Decay on Throned Structures[/h1]
We’ll also be applying a fix to prevent owned pieces from appearing as unclaimed and decaying. Before today’s patch, some structure pieces would display as “Abandoned” despite being connected to a Throne, causing them to start decaying when they shouldn’t be. This has caused a lot of confusion and frustration for many players, and today’s patch will fix this issue.

[h1]Much More[/h1]
We have plenty of other fixes to share today, including a fix to have the UI always show the proper name of your tames, a fix to stop players from harming other players while in a Safe Zone, and much more. Check the full list below for the complete details of today’s patch.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Enemy NPCs can now only damage structures owned by the player they are agro’d on
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some throned structure pieces to become Abandoned and start decaying
[*]Fixed bug stopping Dragons from losing agro when the player is fleeing
[*]Fixed bug allowing mounted players to be harmed in Safe Zones
[*]Fixed an issue causing the build menu to sometimes get stuck in Material Swap mode
[*]Holiday items (Reindeer, Candy Canes, Santa Hats, Milk & Cookies) have been removed
[*]Fixed a bug causing corpse markers to not properly appear in Custom Games
[*]Fixed a bug causing tamed NPCs to not display their proper name on the HUD[/list]

[h1]A Word About Crystal[/h1]
As many of you have may have noticed, Crystal – one of our more populous servers – has been down for the last little while. The issue facing this server is a little more complex than the ones that others have faced in the past, and we will require the assistance of the support team at Epic games.  This, unfortunately, could take some time.

We will continue to work toward a permanent solution to the problem, but for now we’ve decided to make a small roll back in order to get the server up and running again. Following this patch, Crystal should be back, though you may notice a small amount of lost progress (roughly a day’s worth). We’d like to apologize for this inconvenience, and hope it doesn’t disrupt your gameplay experience too significantly.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/a5f0e589a1b7bd1306dcade0ef64059575daf3c4.jpg[/img]

[h1] NOTICE: Removal of Cave Blocking & Glitched Structures Under Map[/h1]
In case you missed it, we recently posted a notice about the removal of structures that are either glitched or block other players from exploring and raiding the game’s caves and dungeons. [b][u]This change will occur in two weeks.[/u][/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791459172333/announcements/detail/2448137522013536605]Check out the relevant post for the full details.[/url]
