notes.title: Hotfix: Enemy HP Improvement / 2018 Content Livestream
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/972a67a79f02009b87f6584c1d8b131a0e05cba2.jpg[/img]

[h1]HP Balance Hotfix[/h1]

As some of you may have noticed, many monster HP values – especially those of some of our higher level enemies – were increased significantly following one of our more recent patches. While increasing the challenge posed by the game's most fierce creatures was an intended design choice, the extent of the increase and abruptness with which it was applied was unintentional. To remedy this problem, we are deploying a patch now to reduce these values to much more reasonable levels. Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.

To illustrate these changes, here are a few points of reference:

[u][b]Level 60 Infernal Dragon HP Pre-Patch:[/b][/u] 66,000
[u][b]Level 60 Infernal Dragon HP Post-Patch[/b][/u] 34,800

[u][b]Level 60 Pyrant HP Pre-Patch:[/b][/u] 55,000
[u][b]Level 60 Pyrant HP Post-Patch:[/b][/u] 29,000

[u][b]Level 60 Giant HP Pre-Patch:[/b][/u] 15,400
[u][b]Level 60 Giant HP Post-Patch:[/b][/u] 8,120

As you can see, we've greatly reduced the health of these monsters to make the experience of battling them a lot less tedious. The bigger enemies were always intended to be tackled by multiple players, but we found that with the old health values even a group of level 60 players would struggle. We hope these changes should bring the experience of fighting these creatures back in line with our intended balance. 

As always, we'd like to thank you for sharing your feedback and exercising patience as we've worked to resolve this issue! We'll continue to monitor the balance of these values as we go forward, and are excited to continue supporting the game with bug fixes, balance changes and new content in the new year.

[h1]2018 Content Q&A Livestream[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e306605739d754acdb25fc3b74ac2183885132a3.jpg[/img]

Join us later today for a first look at farming! We'll be playing with a super early build of the farming system and taking questions from the chat.

www.twitch.tv/playcitadel

notes.title: Patch Notes / Coming in 2018: Broomstick League
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/56be3abdf593d7bfa5a17965399cbaf36162e0a3.jpg[/img]

We hinted at this in the past, and now we’re finally ready to talk more about it: Broomstick League, an intense sport of broomstick-based athletics is coming to Citadel in 2018! Once this new feature is added to the game you’ll be able to assemble a team and challenge strangers and friends to a game of fast paced, adrenaline pumping wizardly athletics. (NOTE: Broomstick League is still very early in development. Mechanics and presentation are subject to change as we continue to work on the project.)

notes.title: Coming in 2018: Farming System
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/07b114eea4cd25e414b2f92eb05a85bd88f894c7.gif[/img]

2017 was a fantastic year for us, but it was also just the beginning. Over the course of the remainder of this week, we’ll be sharing some early first looks at some of the new systems and features we have already well into development for a 2018 release. Today’s feature is one we’ve heard numerous requests for since the launch of the game: Farming is coming to Citadel! (This system is still in development. Presentation and functionality may change.)

[h1]Seeds[/h1]
All big things must start as something small which, in this case, means seeds. To start farming you’ll have to first collect the seeds of the plant you wish to grow by gathering the fully grown plants from around the world. Once you have a selection of the plants you wish to grow, throw them into the Deconstructor to harvest their seeds. The plants will be lost, but the yield of the seeds they drop will more than make up for it once they’re fully grown.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/49ac55ae1841971846db036042c563d55a89d24d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Farming Plots[/h1]
Now that you have your seeds it’s time to build your garden! You’ll first need to unlock the Farming Plot structure piece from the Knowledge Tree (KP cost and level requirement still to be decided). Once you’ve built your plots you can place your seeds in them to begin the process of growing your crops. Crops must be watered, which will require the consumption of mana.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/21efc6876b2ab6cdc8597921315e2ff2e284ae48.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sprinklers[/h1]
Alternative to hand watering your plants, you can also construct Sprinklers. Like Farming Plots, the Sprinkler recipe can be found in the Knowledge Tree (KP cost and level requirement still to be decided).  To take the labor out of farming, simply build these structures and they will continuously shower your crops with water so long as they’re hooked up to Mana Generators. You can even produce Fertilizer (called Hobart’s Growth Solution) to expedite the growth process. Like water, this can be dispersed either by hand or through Sprinklers. Just set it and forget it!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/2604e94bc65b94fd6bbf170cd4ab7926911c45db.jpg[/img]

As you can imagine, plants will be used in some interesting new ways after the Farming System is added to the game. We’ll have more to say about these systems soon, so stay tuned for more details in the future!

notes.title: Citadel in 2017: A Look Back
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d800c53c2027251714bda93f9d6f5b1f38831d08.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon Wizards!

It’s been an exciting year for everyone here at Blue Isle Studios! Since Citadel’s Early Access launch back in July we’ve spent the last 5 months working tirelessly to create new content, crush bugs and tweak gameplay balance. This game has been a passion project for many of us here on the team, and to watch it continue to flourish during its ongoing development has been truly rewarding.

Most of what we’ve worked on has been directly driven by the community’s continued feedback, which has been extremely valuable in the continued effort to refine and expand the game’s core experience. Every day, you share your thoughts and opinions on the forums, on social media and even take the time to vote for your most desired features on our Trello board. To that, we wish to extend a sincere thank you for your continued support!

As we near the year’s end, we’d like to take a moment to reflect upon all the progress we’ve made with Citadel’s development so far. This post will only be focused on listing some of this year’s milestones, but fear not;  While today’s post is about celebrating what has already come, we still have a lot of great stuff currently in the works for next year. 

[b][u](Stay tuned for more posts later this week on the big things we have in store for you guys in 2018!)[/u][/b]

[h1]Endgame Boss Dungeons[/h1]

Our biggest addition for 2017 came in the form of Boss Dungeons: A massive new endgame addition designed to encourage teamplay and seriously challenge the most powerful wizards and witches of Ignus. Each dungeon pits a coordinated party of high-level mages against an intense gauntlet of the game’s strongest monsters, eventually culminating in a battle with an epic boss. Each dungeon rewards adventurers with a ton of rare resources, weapons, armors, and a series of brand-new unique boss loot.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/deba755da566c841d2cccb070ba352475804fa81.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e11c31d809f1995bf5309a78c80da5db37689248.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d38d10408e88d74a6e9a38ef0e6f77298c90d406.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Complete list:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Blood Soul Citadel
[*]Phoenix Soul Citadel
[*]Dragon Heart Citadel[/list]

[h1]New Weapons, Armors & Trinkets[/h1]

One of our early goals for Early Access was to expand the number of equipable items available for players to loot and craft. To that end, we’ve added over 40 new weapons, armors and trinkets to the game since July! Highlights include three full sets of Iron armor, new craftable high level wands, staves, melee weapons and gauntlets, and an entire selection of new top-quality weapons and armors exclusive to boss dungeons.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f448e5c4fbcaa562e9e35ca242cfe8a49cf28eaa.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1b753f1f950fbc83a40c66935a5355297c842b52.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Complete list:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Wand of Thorns
[*]Staff of Sacrifice
[*]Blade of Simeon’s Soul
[*]Bear Claw Gauntlet
[*]Iron Armor (Full Set)
[*]Tempered Iron Armor (Full Set)
[*]Dark Iron Armor (Full Set)
[*]Unique Boss Armors (3 Full Sets)
[*]Unique Boss Weapons (3 Total)
[*]Boss Dungeon Armor Variants (12 Total)
[*]Boss Dungeon Weapon Variants (12 Total)[/list]

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]

We’ve also done our best to maintain a steady supply of new enemies entering Citadel’s bestiary.  Since launch we’ve added a slew of new monsters including fiery Phoenixes, devastating Infernal Dragons, ghastly Abominations, heavenly Divine Unicorns and three gargantuan Dungeon Bosses! As with all creatures, these new enemies can become allies via pacification (with the exception of bosses), and many of them can be mounted! We want to continue this tradition into 2018, so stay tuned for more info on future creature additions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6f493125dc74d9ffe2aafbdd772329cac2d36063.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ef456c5156ec9ca054c34f3d6c2be07c1f6ff8f9.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Complete list:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Divine Unicorn
[*]Phoenix
[*]Abomination
[*]Infernal Dragon
[*]Skeleton Warriors  (Basic, Flaming and Armored)
[*]Wild Boar 
[*]Dracul
[*]Evren (Dragon Boss)
[*]Helios & Corona (Phoenix Bosses)
[*]Orcus (Demon Boss)[/list]

[h1]New Structure Pieces/Functionality[/h1]

Building is a massive part of the game, and one many of our fans point to as their favorite component of Citadel. We heard this loud and clear after launch, and started to work immediately on adding some new content to the already robust system.  From new aesthetic options – like furniture, decorative items and Marble pieces – to entirely new functionalities – like material swapping, upgradeable towers and false/trap doors – we’ve done our best to empower you, the community, in your quest to express your creativity. Stay tuned for more structure improvements in the future!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/60c67d704024c2e198ed77d4faaa99cba47a7215.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/71d1feba1f9db4d3acf7ab26155ff0346b8f17eb.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9e6f002c0801cd5d82c6578ffe2ed527017cdbe3.gif[/img]

[b][u]Complete list:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Marble Construction Set
[*]Furniture Pieces (Chairs, Tables, etc)
[*]Decorative pieces (Paintings, Torches, Statues, etc)
[*]Trap/Hidden Doors (Trap Floor Panels, False Bookshelf Doors)
[*]Traps (Spikes & Acid Pits)
[*]Upgradeable Defensive and Offensive Attack Towers
[*]Structure Material Swapping System[/list]

[h1]Optimization and Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]

Though our designers and artists spend a lot of time creating new gameplay content, our programmers spend the bulk of their time focused on refining the games foundation and improving the game’s performance and improving bugs. We can’t list all the bugs we’ve fixed since launch here, but anyone who’s been following our patch notes know that we’ve been on top of correcting the worst bugs that come up.

We’ve also been working extra hard at improving the overall user experience. Many menus and systems have been receiving a consistent polishing to ensure that things look nice and work smoothly.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d3122d05946bf2251d756ff2f2974c926fbab64d.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c6e09839c574a07cee2757cc411c6b47d5dfcaf7.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/099b1ed478d56baf8105077f199191418ff876ec.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Here’s but a select list of some of the highlights from this year:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Corpse Marker
[*]Throne Health Indicator
[*]Auto Run/Default Run
[*]Keybinding Options Improvements
[*]Server Improvements
[*]Client Optimization
[*]Chat System Improvements
[*]Tame Menu Overhaul
[*]Server Browser Overhaul
[*]Settings Menu Overhaul
[*]Custom Game Menu Overhaul
[*]Map Overhaul[/list]

Since launch we’ve added a slew of new monsters including fiery Phoenixes, devastating Infernal Dragons, ghastly Abominations, heavenly Divine Unicorns and three gargantuan Dungeon Bosses!

From new aesthetic options – like furniture, decorative items and Marble pieces – to entirely new functionalities – like material swapping, upgradeable towers and false/trap doors – we’ve done our best to empower you, the community, in your quest to express your creativity.

Since launch we’ve added a slew of new monsters including fiery Phoenixes, devastating Infernal Dragons, ghastly Abominations, heavenly Divine Unicorns and three gargantuan Dungeon Bosses! As with all creatures, these new enemies can become allies via pacification (with the exception of bosses), and many of them can be mounted! We want to continue this tradition into 2018, so stay tuned for more info on future creature additions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6f493125dc74d9ffe2aafbdd772329cac2d36063.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ef456c5156ec9ca054c34f3d6c2be07c1f6ff8f9.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Complete list:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Divine Unicorn
[*]Phoenix
[*]Abomination
[*]Infernal Dragon
[*]Skeleton Warriors  (Basic, Flaming and Armored)
[*]Wild Boar 
[*]Dracul
[*]Evren (Dragon Boss)
[*]Helios & Corona (Phoenix Bosses)
[*]Orcus (Demon Boss)[/list]

[h1]New Structure Pieces/Functionality[/h1]

Building is a massive part of the game, and one many of our fans point to as their favorite component of Citadel. We heard this loud and clear after launch, and started to work immediately on adding some new content to the already robust system.  From new aesthetic options – like furniture, decorative items and Marble pieces – to entirely new functionalities – like material swapping, upgradeable towers and false/trap doors – we’ve done our best to empower you, the community, in your quest to express your creativity. Stay tuned for more structure improvements in the future!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/60c67d704024c2e198ed77d4faaa99cba47a7215.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/71d1feba1f9db4d3acf7ab26155ff0346b8f17eb.gif[/img]

[b][u]Complete list:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Marble Construction Set
[*]Furniture Pieces (Chairs, Tables, etc)
[*]Decorative pieces (Paintings, Torches, Statues, etc)
[*]Trap/Hidden Doors (Trap Floor Panels, False Bookshelf Doors)
[*]Traps (Spikes & Acid Pits)
[*]Upgradeable Defensive and Offensive Attack Towers
[*]Structure Material Swapping System[/list]

[h1]Optimization and Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]

Though our designers and artists spend a lot of time creating new gameplay content, our programmers spend the bulk of their time focused on refining the games foundation and improving the game’s performance and improving bugs. We can’t list all the bugs we’ve fixed since launch here, but anyone who’s been following our patch notes know that we’ve been on top of correcting the worst bugs that come up.

We’ve also been working extra hard at improving the overall user experience. Many menus and systems have been receiving a consistent polishing to ensure that things look nice and work smoothly.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12/14/2017 - Netcode Improvements & Holiday Content
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5942c0833ec16ad0a37cadf76815f47f90ed0045.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! We’re ready to start rolling out this week’s patch! 

Today’s update is packed to the brim with holiday cheer. We’ve added Santa hats, Milk & Cookie consumables, wild Reindeer NPCs and a few other goodies to keep the winter spirit alive in Ignus. Track down world chests to loot the new items. Every item drops at a 100% drop rate!

More importantly, as mentioned in yesterday’s preview, we have some significant netcode tweaks on the game’s backend. Players should see improvements in both lag and load times, and users with slower connections should experience less difficulty with their initial attempts to join servers

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/a7a468abca6e0346b374bd7545621ca3cc3591d9.jpg[/img]

Please see [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1466349626714806771]yesterday’s preview post[/url] for more detail on this update’s highlights.

As always, the full list of changes can be found below. Be sure to allow Steam to update your client, and give the servers time to come back up with the newest version of the game. Please feel free to share your feedback on the forums, and we’ll see you in Ignus!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Implemented several backend netcode refactors to improve server connectivity
[*]Milk and Cookies added to world chests
[*]Santa Hats added to world chests
[*]Deer NPCs have received holiday re-design
[*]Enemy NPCs will now properly aggro when attacked from afar
[*]NPCs now less likely to get stuck on terrain/foliage
[*]Fixed a bug causing tamed NPC HUD to display incorrect information
[*]Fixed a bug in the chest menu causing all item counts to display as 0
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some players to lose ownership of structures after a house disbanded[/list]

notes.title: Patch Preview - Netcode Improvements & Holiday Content
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9b9d9dde4fc9ac876f420011c9a7ecf9d15747a3.jpg[/img]

[b]UPDATE:[/b] This patch will unfortunately be delayed a day due to last minute technical issues. Apologies for the inconvenience.

The holiday spirit is coming to Citadel! 

While the true highlight with this week’s upcoming patch is a series of network improvements on the game’s backend – which should improve server performance and reduce connectivity errors for some players – we’re also adding a nice sprinkling of holiday cheer into the game for the good wizards and witches of Ignus! Let’s take a quick peek at what you can expect to see in the game come tomorrow’s patch.

[h1]Connectivity Improvements [/h1]
Tomorrow's update will include refactors of a number of key back end systems that manage the communication of world and player data between the server and the client. With these changes, many players should see improvements in load times and a reduction in lag. Additionally, players with slower connections who once experienced difficulties connecting to servers should experience fewer instances of clicking “Join” and being kicked back to the main menu. 

[h1]AI Improvements[/h1]
We’ve made a few tweaks to our AI behavior and responsiveness that should hopefully make some enemies pose a bit more of a threat in combat. Previous to this update, some enemies would not elicit a response as you sniped them with spells from afar. We’ve made adjustments to correct this. Additionally, tames should have less trouble navigating the world’s geometry and foliage.

[h1]Festive Cheer[/h1]
The season of giving is upon us, and we have a couple fun time-limited goodies to share as our gift to you! Because we’ve been so busy with netcode development and the preparation of our endgame dungeon content the scope of our winter content is a little smaller than that of our Halloween event.

[b][u]Santa Hats[/u][/b]
There’s no way we could have a holiday event without making a Santa hat! This fetching crimson cap will keep your head nice and warm as you trek through the frigid Tundra while hunting for rare resources and Boss Shards. We’ve applied some physics this thing, which gives the end of the hat a charming bob as you gleefully hop and skip through the winter wonderland!
From now until the end of the event all world chests will drop Santa hats with a 100% drop rate. Think of it as our little gift to you. Simply raid a camp or clear a cave and you’ll be good to spread the holiday joy!

[b][u]Milk & Cookies[/u][/b]
Chests will also contain Milk and Cookies consumables which can be eaten to buff your health regeneration and movement speed. These tasty confections are also consistently found in chests, so if you’re ever out adventuring and need a pick-me-up, hit up the nearest enemy camp for a sweet holiday treat!

[b][u]Reindeers[/u][/b]
Tame and ride festive reindeer! From now until the end of our event, all deer will spawn with bright, red noses. Do these holiday deer have different stats, or behave any different? No! Is it still awesome? Heck yes!

[h1]Much More![/h1]
As always, we’ll have more minor bug fixes and improvements included in the full update, so stay tuned for the complete patch notes tomorrow!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12/06/2017 - Shard Drops Increased & Boss Dungeon Rebalances
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7170eea685552b16f069292a3670e8a813dc844d.gif[/img]

[b]Good afternoon, Wizards![/b]

We're so excited to finally have our huge Forsaken Crypts update out there for everyone to play! Countless hours were spent designing and creating the various dungeons, bosses and items within it, and to see people engage with the new content has been extremely fulfilling for us here at Blue Isle Studios.

As with any major update, there has been a ton of feedback -- both positive and negative. While we're happy to accept the praise, we've really been interested in digesting some of the constructive criticisms you, the community, have offered us since the update's launch. To that end, we've taken the opportunity to use today's patch to address some of the more common boss dungeon comments.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/143942b453ad17e4096adfbc2bd741d26634447f.gif[/img]

First and foremost, we've taken your feedback to heart and have [b]increased the drop rate of the boss dungeon shards[/b]. While we do want these items to remain quite rare, many players reported spending hours hunting without the slightest hint of a drop. This is certainly a little more extreme than we anticipated, so we've made some changes to hopefully improve the overall shard-farming experience.

We've also made a number of tweaks to the dungeons themselves based on player feedback. We've altered a few parts of the terrain to reduce the cheeseability of some of the bosses, made adjustments to the power and behaviour of the bosses themselves to make them a little more imposing, and have made some striking aesthetic changes to enhance the mood and atmosphere of the dungeons themselves. Take a look at our pretty new lava, for example: 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9766d1b8d80a09a58ec644e8534169683d26e75b.jpg[/img]

On top of that, we've made a number of fixes outside of the boss dungeons. An exploit that allowed some players to use Telekinesis on structures owned by other players has been fixed, along with a bug that prevented some of the resources scattered across Ignus to be harvested. Additionally, falling damage has been decreased.

As always, we've compiled a complete list of the changes below. Take a look, give the servers time to come back up, and share your feedback in the forums! Thank you for continuing to support Citadel as we work through our Early Access journey. We look forward to seeing you in Ignus!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list][*]Telekinesis no longer works on doors owned by other players
[*]The second Boss Phoenix no longer gets healed after the first dies
[*]Boss Phoenixes can no longer hurt each other with their Tornados
[*]Boss phoenixes can no longer level-up
[*]Fixed a bug that caused boss chests to refill every 5 minutes
[*]Fixed instances of abusable terrain in boss arena entrances
[*]Falling damage reduced
[*]Fixed issues with spell physics affecting party members
[*]Fixed an issue preventing beach rocks from being collected
[*]Shard drop rates slightly increased
[*]Aesthetic changes to Blood Soul Dungeon
[*]New lava pools in Dragon’s Heart Dungeon
[*]Fixed spell spamming issues with weapon switching
[*]Fixed various server crashes[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12/01/2017 - Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey guys, we just submitted a patch today which is mostly cleanup, bug fixing and back end work. Here's a bit of a summary on the fixes that went in today as well as an extended list of patch fixes that were included with the latest release.

[b]Fixed Today:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue that affected creatures from properly respawning in the Forgotten Crypts
    [*]Spells that apply force will no longer affect gargantuan creatures
    [*]Multiple server stability fixes
[/list]

[b]Fixed in the latest release:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Beam spells should now properly clean up instead of lingering on clients
    [*]Fixed issues where some characters could get into a state that did not allow them to log back into the server
    [*]Improvements to NPC targeting and ranged attack selection
    [*]Navigation mesh generation time improvements
    [*]Multiple client crash fixes
    [*]Fixed an issue where loot chests would sometimes not be interactable
    [*]Fixed areas where footsteps and landing sounds were missing
    [*]Fixed an issue where the player map arrow could disappear
    [*]Fixed an issue where NPC's would not be flying while dismounted mid-air
    [*]New lava shaders added to improve volcanic environment look and feel
    [*]Improved NPC server performance
    [*]NPC movement speed and pathing improvements
    [*]Knockback effects no longer affect partied members
    [*]Animation reacts only happen on critical strike, added a subtle shader effect to acknowledge connected hits
    [*]Fixed an issue where switching weapons while charging would cause the effects to persist
    [*]Fixed the Deathweaver's kiss of death spell to properly show effects
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - The Forsaken Crypts
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9b37f6da9987f8aaf76f8cc2f6e3f996125154af.gif[/img]

[h1]Accessing the New Boss Dungeons [/h1]
Accessing the three new boss dungeons will take time, patience and strength. The first step in the process is to find the hidden mausoleums that house the entrances to these new challenges. Each mausoleum is situated on its own island, all three of which are brand new and have sprung up somewhere in the world of Ignus. Within each of these mausoleums is a pedestal, upon which you will have to place an arcane stone to open a portal to the relevant dungeon.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/deba755da566c841d2cccb070ba352475804fa81.jpg[/img]

To acquire these stones you will have to explore the world, slay high-level beasts and collect rare shards. Shards have been added to the game as extremely rare drops from the creatures that roam the Tundra. It is advisable to gather a party and pool your efforts toward collecting these shards. You will need ten of them to create a stone.

Dragon’s Heart Shards, which are used to create the Dragon’s Heart Stone, are the one exception to this process. Unlike Blood Soul Shards and Phoenix Soul Shards, they can only be found from drops in the Blood Soul Citadel and Phoenix Soul Citadel. This is because the Dragon’s Heart Citadel is the ultimate challenge, and demands that a wizard first prove his or her worth.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/78756cc8a22b4a927266bc397a4a79c153ebbee3.gif[/img]

The creation of these legendary stones – Blood Soul Stone, Phoenix Soul Stone and Dragon’s Heart Stone – is managed via the crafting system. After the update drops, everyone will receive these recipes for free under the Inventory heading in their crafting menu. Simply craft the stone, take it to the relevant mausoleum, and place it on the pedestal. You and your party will now be able to use the pedestal to instantly teleport to the dungeon. A 1 hour time limit is imposed upon each run, so make sure you’re ready.

[h1]New Weapons & Armors[/h1]
We want these dungeons to feel special, and worth replaying multiple times. To that end, we’ve created a ton of dungeon-exclusive new armor and weapon variants specifically balanced for high level, end-game play. You can unlock these amazing new items by looting the chests and monsters that have been liberally sprinkled through each cave.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ea3d452b2c7579a49663158d541a899c311b730d.gif[/img]

Additionally, as a reward for fully completing a dungeon, each boss will randomly drop pieces from three brand new weapon and armor sets. These are specifically themed around the motif of the dungeon and boss.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5ca481b500a1591fa4cbd09cd7b09a9cbf9199bf.jpg[/img]

Even further, we’ve also added three new sets of craftable weapons and armors to the game, available through non-dungeon play. The Wand of Thorns, Staff of Sacrifice and Dark Iron armor set have been added as new top-level crafting options for each of their respective item types. 

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
Another smaller change worth noting is the new flight visual effects we’ve added to the game. Every flight potion and broomstick has been given its own unique visual style to enhance the experience of progressing through the flight trees.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/503cab9349eed3ce6ab879fcae4115fac4e20d98.gif[/img]

Check out the full list of changes below, and enjoy our first big addition to the Citadel: Forged with Fire endgame. See you in Ignus!

[list][*]Three new endgame dungeons: Blood Soul Citadel, Phoenix Soul Citadel and Dragon’s Heart Citadel
[*]Three new boss monsters within each dungeon
[*]Three new sets of unique boss armor
[*]Boss dungeon shards now drop from Tundra monsters
[*]A large selection of new armor and weapon variants (dungeon drop exclusive)
[*]New flight visual effects
[*]Two new craftable weapons: Wand of Thorns and Staff of Sacrifice
[*]One new craftable armor set: Dark Iron Armor[/list]

notes.title: The Forsaken Crypts Expansion: Available FREE November 30th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d3c506784c4e3924b0e95b61dfde630251d702cb.png[/img]

Mysteriously and without warning, three ancient mausoleums have emerged on Ignus. Originally built to honor the mighty Wizard Kings who once ruled the land, these formerly palatial fortresses have since fallen into disrepair. Three savage behemoths, each with an army of twisted monsters at their disposal, have taken hold of the treacherous dungeons. 

It is said that priceless riches and powerful artifacts await any adventurer courageous enough to banish the twisted evils that occupy the three crumbling strongholds. Will you be so bold? Gear up, rally your allies and keep your wits about you. Fortune and glory awaits only the strongest and bravest heroes!

The Forsaken Crypts Expansion is Citadel: Forged with Fire’s first huge update, and adds a variety of exciting new features and content including:


[h1]CHALLENGING ENDGAME DUNGEONS[/h1]
Fight your way through three nightmarish new endgame encounters! From frigid caves of jagged ice to sweeping fields of sizzling lava, each dungeon presents a unique challenge designed specifically for high level party play. Gather a group of friends and prepare for the fight of your wizarding life!

[h1]POWERFUL BOSS ENEMIES[/h1]
Each new dungeon ends in a desperate battle with one of three new boss monsters. These monsters have been given completely unique spells that will force you and your team to communicate clearly and keep your wits about you. Many will challenge them, few will survive.

[h1]NEW WEAPONS, ARMORS AND ITEMS[/h1]
Play and replay the new boss dungeons to earn a variety of all-new epic lootables! We’ve added a slew of new weapon, armor and trinket varieties to the game to make each run of the boss dungeons rewarding and exciting. Among these items are three new sets of extremely powerful armors and weapons that can only be earned by slaying the mighty bosses themselves. 

[h1]MUCH MORE[/h1]
This massive update also includes a number of gameplay tweaks, bug fixes and visual improvements. Combined with the content we’ve released since launch – new structure pieces and functionality, tons of new creatures, weapons, armors and items, new spells , server optimizations and new gameplay systems – Citadel is now the best it’s ever been!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9b37f6da9987f8aaf76f8cc2f6e3f996125154af.gif[/img]

notes.title: Coming Soon: New Unique Armors
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ea3d452b2c7579a49663158d541a899c311b730d.gif[/img]

Along with three new dungeons, each with their own unique boss monster encounter, our upcoming Forsaken Crypts expansion also includes a ton of new endgame weapons and armors for you to loot, unlock and craft. Among these new items are three new sets of items, each tied to the various themes of the new dungeons. Pieces of these extremely powerful sets can be earned only by completing a dungeon and defeating its ruling boss monster; you’ll have to complete the dungeons multiple times if you want to collect the entire set!

[h1]Dracul Armor Set[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/4c2982ff0dd31b0865bb5172df12b1fb3fc1a005.jpg[/img]
This smoldering armor harnesses the power of the ancient volcano that turned the immaculate Dragon’s Heart Citadel into an uninhabitable inferno thousands of years ago. Recovered from the deepest part of the immense lava drift that threads its way through the Citadel’s narrow passageways, this armor provides a hefty amount of defensive capability. 

[h1]Pyrant Armor Set[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/17fe0934a98d7efcbc43e885b0f9ebe044f66a77.jpg[/img]
Tthe Pyrant set exudes an inexplicable aura of coldness, yet provides an oddly warming sensation when worn by its owner. Dropped by the icy demonic presence that resides at the extreme depths of the Blood Soul Citadel, this armor set will often confer a variety of stat bonuses to the wizards who are strong enough to acquire it. 

[h1]Helios Armor Set[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f770e26333a154183483e95b9d631657b728e3a0.jpg[/img]
The transcendent power that pulsates from this glorious set of unique armor could only have come from the massive twin Phoenixes who have found a home for themselves in the Phoenix Spirit Citadel. Only those who can defeat these indomitable creatures may don this protective set and wield their power heavenly power.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/33be33c85392b36da9233aeebc5acd83cb9567ee.jpg[/img]

As many of you may already be aware, we’ll be adding a series of treacherous endgame boss fights in a massive expansion planned for release later this month. To accommodate the addition of these substantial new environments, as well as a new set of rules to our building system, we’ll need to make a few adjustments to the existing layout of Ignus.

[h1]Clearout Zones for Upcoming Content[/h1]
Three new parts of the map will soon be added to the game. We’ve taken the liberty of outlining these areas in-game with gigantic blue borders. These spaces are out in the middle of the ocean, so it’s likely that very few (if any) players have actually built here. In the event that you do have a structure here, please be warned that it will be deleted once the upcoming expansion is released. We advise you to begin the process of moving your structure, lest you suffer the loss of your hard work and precious resources.

[h1]Throne Influence Radius Increase[/h1]
We’ll also be making an adjustment to how close you can build to other players. Historically, strangers could build within one empty space of another player’s structure. In two weeks we’ll be bumping this up to fifteen. This change is intended to prevent griefers from encasing another player’s structure, which we’ve received many reports about in the past. This change will not apply to Housemates, who will still be allowed to build within the existing radius of one space.

When this change goes into effect, any pre-existing structure that is within the radius of another unknown player’s structure will be rendered un-alterable. You will be able to delete these pieces and reclaim their resources, but additional building will not be allowed. If you are currently extremely close to an unknown player’s structure, we’d advise you consider this change before its implementation in two weeks.

tags.feature: Three new parts of the map will soon be added to the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 11/8/2017 - Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/67b4e7e7547285a728422a9ca4049082efdd4511.gif[/img]

Another patch is ready to roll out, dear Wizards! Today we push out another of our minor patches, which means we’re focusing on fixing bugs and improving the gameplay experience. Today’s update tidies up some lingering issues with our newly implemented structure upgrading system, while also fixing some of the community’s more frequently reported bugs.

Something that will be interesting to many players are the changes we’ve made to how we manage and communicate throne decay in-game. A couple new improvements have been added to the game that we believe should alleviate some of the confusion and frustration many players have expressed regarding this system. 

The first change in that regard is that we now display your throne’s health in a place where you can easily find it at all times. The icon which represents your throne on both the compass and game’s map will show your throne’s health as a fill effect in the background of the image. It also has three distinct visual cues: green means your throne's health is full or close to full, orange means your throne is damaged, and flashing red means your throne's health is critical. Now you’ll always be fully aware of the status of your throne.

The second change we’ve made to thrones is to ease the burden of our decay system. Many players don’t realize that they need to heal their throne regularly to prevent it from decaying, which can often result in the unexpected loss of their structure. The decay system is designed to remove structures owned by inactive players, so that a server's active players can enjoy a smoother, less sluggish experience. To make this experience cleaner, less tedious, and less confusing we’ve made it so your throne will automatically get its health topped up each time you log into the server. 

Additionally, we have some awesome fixes to a few critical bugs. We’ve stamped out a nasty bug that caused frequent crashes for some players when equipping and unequipping certain armors, we’ve fixed an issue that has caused some Mana Generators to not properly power certain Magic Structures, and we’ve even fixed a bug that caused chests to become non –functional for some Custom Game players! Check out the full list of changes in today’s patch below, and let us know what you think of these recent changes  in the comments, on the forums, and on our official Twitter!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Throne health is now automatically refilled on login
[*]Throne health is now indicated on the Compass and Map
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some Mana Generators to not power some Magic Structures
[*]Fixed a bug that caused crashes when swapping some armors
[*]Fixed a bug that caused loot chests to become non-functional in Custom Games
[*]Fixed a bug that caused upgraded Defensive Towers to not damage players who are at full health
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed Defensive Towers to be upgraded for free[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 11/3/2017 - Material Swapping & Tower Upgrading
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/77709ae58c1af5fb366405dd32c4ef2fd416f9d5.gif[/img]

Good morning, Wizards! We've prepared another major update to add some exciting new functionality to the game as our Halloween event comes to a close. We hope you enjoyed unlocking costumes and trick or treating!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9D5APKLPy4
The bulk of today's new content is focused on expanding the capabilities of our building system. Attack towers and defensive towers can now be upgraded, allowing interesting new dynamics for home defense planning. Additionally, structure materials on existing buildings can now be upgraded without the tedium of destroying and rebuilding! [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1447205823386888497]Check out our previous post on these new systems for more details.[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/60c67d704024c2e198ed77d4faaa99cba47a7215.gif[/img]

Another fetching new feature not previously mentioned in our patch preview is the addition of a raid warning screen. Now, I'd someone has attacked and destroyed your Throne, even if you were offline, you will receive a handy notice.

As always, there are a handful of very nice bug fixes and gameplay improvements included in today's patch notes, so be sure to look below to see all the details. We hope you enjoy these new features and fresh content, and hope to see you in Ignus soon!

[list][*]New System: Material swapping for structure pieces
[*]New System: Three tiers of upgradability for Arcane Obelisks, Obelisks of Flames, Obelisks of Protection and Warding Obelisks
[*]A new pop up will notify you if your throne has been destroyed
[*]Fixed an issue where players could bind functions to the Escape key
[*]Further fixes implemented for sound orientation issues
[*]Fixed an issue that caused some loot chests to not properly refill
[*]Node respawn times have been changed from 24 hours to 4 hours
[*]Nodes no longer respawn within structures on server restart
[*]Halloween effects removed from the world
[*]Halloween items no longer appear in chests[/list]

notes.title: Patch Preview – Material Swapping & Tower Upgrading
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/71d1feba1f9db4d3acf7ab26155ff0346b8f17eb.gif[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! This week we'll be deploying our next patch on Thursday! We’ve been working hard on some excellent new game mechanics to further flesh out our structure building system. Today we’ll take a look at what you can expect once the patch hits later this week.

[h1]Material Swapping [/h1]
One of the most frequently requested additions to our building system has been the ability to upgrade existing structures. Many players have expressed a desire to swap between structure materials without going through the tedious process of completely destroying and rebuilding their entire castle. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/a1d2ad3f7a5c551dd11a4edfff96868e6c2b5776.gif[/img]

Following our update, you’ll be able to swap any structure piece to a different material with the click of a button. Simply navigate to the material you want in the Build Menu, scroll to the recycle icon, and click on the piece you want to change! Doing so will cost you the resources it’d take to build the piece, but you’ll also still receive the same structure piece refund you would get for simply deleting.

[h1]Defensive & Offensive Tower Upgrading [/h1]
In addition to material swapping, we’re also giving some love to our defensive and offensive towers to make the experience of fortifying your base more meaningful and engaging.  Each tower has been given an additional two levels of power that increases their strength and alters their behavior.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/60c67d704024c2e198ed77d4faaa99cba47a7215.gif[/img]

[b]Attack Towers[/b] can now have their power significantly improved. Level up your Arcane Obelisks and Obelisks of Flames with Flawless Rune Gems and Enchanted Stones to significantly boost to their overall damage. As you continue to upgrade them they’ll receive further boosts to both their Critical Hit chance and overall Critical Hit damage. A fully upgraded tower is capable of dishing out some truly devastating damage!

[b]Defensive Towers[/b] on the other hand are all about having their functionality augmented. By investing Enchanted Stones and Flawless Rune Gems into your Obelisks of Protection and Warding Obelisks, you can have them apply a buff or a debuff to your allies and enemies. For allies, upgraded defensive towers will provide healing to any friendly players within their radius.  For enemies, upgraded defensive towers will apply some nasty damage over time to any raiders who may set foot on your claimed land. 

[h1]Halloween Event Ends[/h1]
A quick reminder for those last minute trick-or-treaters: Our Halloween event ends with this next patch! Get in-game now and unlock all the costumes and candies before they're gone for good!

[h1]Much More[/h1]
We'll have more info to share with you all on Thursday, including bug fixes and gameplay tweaks.Stay tuned for the full patch notes, and we'll see you in Ignus with some brand new content soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/26/2017 - Auto Run & Much More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3805a80475f09b0851fe2f7b9f791fa456b0a0d1.png[/img]

We’re ready to put out another quick set of bug fixes and gameplay improvements to supplement yesterday’s patch. With today’s patch, we’ve added a couple new features to make long trips and general traversal a much less tedious experience.

The first thing we added was a hot key for Auto Run. Say you want to fly a long distance on your dragon, but don’t want to sit and watch the trip. Simply hit the Auto Run key (default binding is Num Lock) and your character will essentially be on cruise control! You can change this key to whatever you like by opening the Keybinds tab in the Settings menu.

The second traversal improvement is a new Settings option that many players have requested over the last few months: Default Run. If you enable this option in the Game Settings menu your character will default all movement to running rather than walking, and will instead walk when the Shift key (or whatever you’ve bound it to) is held. 

We’ve also implemented a number of other fixes, including some polish for yesterday’s Custom Game spawn fix, a fix for XP bars in the Tame Menu, ambient sound fixes and even an exploit fix that allowed mounted players to see into other peoples’ castles. Take a look at the full list below for all the details, and make sure to give the servers enough time to come back up with the latest version of the game. Thank you again for all your support and feedback as we work through our Early Access run, and we’ll see you soon in Ignus!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1][list]
[*]Can now toggle Auto Run with Num Lock (rebindable)
[*]Default Run option added to Game Settings menu
[*]Fixed an issue with our recent Custom Game Start Town spawn fix
[*]Fixed XP bars in the Tame Menu not working properly
[*]Fixed instances where world ambiance would cut out
[*]Fixed an exploit that allowed players on mounts to see through structural walls
[*]Fixed Mana Generators sometimes not feeding Magic Structures[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/25/2017 - Tame Desync & More
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/a45213b8dc189a6e0b39173fed0e1b1ba7a1922d.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! Today’s patch continues our new weekly cycle between major patches and minor patches by introducing our second minor patch. As you may remember, minor patch weeks are smaller in scale and are more focused on bug fixes and balance tweaks rather than new content and gameplay systems. 

Our biggest fix in this week’s patch resolves the on-going issue of tame desynchronization. Many players have recently experienced strange behavior with their tames seemingly disappearing for no reason or becoming stuck and non-functional in their game. These instances are a result of a desynchronization between the player’s client and the game’s server. This problem has now been fixed with today’s update.

Many Custom Game players have also reported that they always log in at a starter town rather than in the place where they last logged off, causing for the frustrating experience of traveling home every time they play. notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/18/2017 - Halloween Begins!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d4abd5869eff0800fba747c45fa6ef05a2b0ad94.jpg[/img]

Spooky Afternoon, Spooksters of Ignus! We’re finally ready to unleash the horrors of Halloween into the world with our very special Halloween Event! Starting right now and [b][u]ending November 1st[/u][/b], you can enjoy the joy of trick-or-treating here in Citadel!

[h1]How To Trick-or-Treat[/h1]
[b][u]Step One: Find a World Chest[/u][/b]
Every good trick-or-treater has a plan of attack! Know your destinations; Halloween treats can be found in any of the treasure chests that populate the enemy camps, caves and other various noteworthy locales in Ignus. 

[b][u]Step Two: Clear The Enemies[/u][/b]
Show the chest’s guardians the true meaning of Halloween fear! Clear out the camp or cave and the treasure will be yours to plunder. Be sure to come prepared for a fight. The higher tier the chest, the stronger the enemies that surround it will be.

[b][u]Step Three: Loot Your Treats![/u][/b]
It’s treat time! Cross your fingers and crack open the chest! Each type of reward comes in multiple varieties with differing drop rates. Keep trick or treating to collect them all before the event ends!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d941f8c81a47b35e2b932941800aba06e51c9c4b.png[/img]

If you’d like to learn more about the types of new content you can get through Trick or Treating, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1450581863748869974]check out our preview post from earlier! [/url]

[h1]Crafting Persists on Server Restart[/h1]
Your prayers have been answered! Now you can safely load up your various crafting structures with resources and not have to worry about losing your resources if the server happens to go down when you are away. Want to build an enormous Marble structure? Load your Forges up with Stone, go to sleep, and safely return the next day to a beautiful stack of Slabs, ready for you to start creating your masterpiece!

[h1]Third Person Improvements[/h1]
We’ve made major improvements to the experience of playing the game in third person! We’ve added a slew of new, much more natural animations to make your character look less awkward. Gone are the days of stiff running!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c5a1ec83caa5e17dbd84eeed77de9b5175504fc7.gif[/img]

Additionally, the camera has been greatly improved in third person. Your character will now face toward the reticule, opting to strafe or back pedal rather than always running in the direction you push. Even better, when your character is standing still, you are now able to freely rotate the camera! This will make taking glamour shots of your mage so much easier!

[h1]Much More![/h1]
Check out the patch notes below for the full details of what’s new with today’s update! We’re delighted to share the new update with you, and can’t wait to hear how you’re enjoying the new content. As always, we’ll be listening for your feedback, so please feel free to share on the forums. Make sure you give the servers a moment to come back up with the newest version of the game, and we hope to see you in the new SPOOOOOOKY Ignus!

[h1]Time-Limited Content[/h1]
[list][*]New Content: Three Spooky Ghost costume variants available in chests
[*]New Content: Two spooky Pumpkin head costume variants available in chests
[*]New Content: Two Monster Mask costume variants available in chests
[*]New Content: Four Halloween candies and chocolates available in chests
[*]Ignus has been made spOoOoOkier (red moon, spooky props, scary town names)[/list]

[h1]Structures[/h1]
[list][*]New Content: Trapdoor structure piece
[*]New Content: Two types of Spike Traps structure pieces
[*]New Content: Acid Pool structure piece
[*]New Content: Three Tombstone building props
[*]Crafting benches now properly save materials and continue working after server restarts
[*]Graphical improvements to structure piece preview[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list] [*]Significant improvements to third person animation and camera behaviour
[*]New tutorial stone UI pop ups
[*]Fixed map screen related crashes
[*]Respawn button now available in pause menu[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e68d2a15a90a4404f958f5c7c69ea64fe2e47a5f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Horror Is Coming...
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/cf5dcdf0dbff0856ff5fac12c12241d439feabeb.jpg[/img]

Brace yourselves, Mages: Halloween horror will soon be descending upon the realm of Ignus! Come this [b]Wednesday, October 18th[/b] we’ll be adding a host of [i]spoOoOoOoOoOoOoky[/i] new content to Citadel in celebration of everyone’s favorite freaky festivity. 

[h1]Spookified World![/h1]
To really embrace the mood of the holiday we’ve cranked Ignus’ general freakiness up to 11. The nights are freakier, foggier and more terrifying than ever. Rumor has it that on some rare nights the moon shines blood red! Keep your wits about you, lest an Abomination tear you to shreds!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3805a80475f09b0851fe2f7b9f791fa456b0a0d1.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c2287bcf9b18f2e2216bc669eda65c0c57df6b51.png[/img]

[h1]Time-Limited Treats![/h1]
After next Wednesday’s update it’s time to go trick-or-treating! Every camp and cave treasure chest in the world will have a chance to drop some terrifying time-limited goodies. Some will be common, some will be less so, and some will be downright rare! The event ends [b]November 1st[/b], so make sure you grab the goodies before the chance has truly ghosted!  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/72fe9e686d46ddf099f4762ee3f7fae55c468c11.png[/img]

The most common of these temporary delights is a selection of delicious candies! Chow down on a variety of cloying sweet delights including Chocolate Kaltibur Crisps, Sweet Crowberry Gum, Chocolate Buffalo Duds and Sugar Sprite Sticks and enjoy a variety of Health Regen, Mana Regen and Movement Speed buffs!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6f04a64e82b9fd4a90e66fe74aafcbfaee43f245.gif[/img]

We’re also preparing a huge selection of fun and ghoulish costumes, masks and helmets to really help you get in the spirit of the holiday! Some of these items, ridiculous though they may seem, are actually extremely viable high-end armor items – scoop them up while you can! More details on these costume items to follow in the coming week, so stay tuned!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/561ac825ec36137ffd90b4c3edec465495897a66.gif[/img]

[h1]Devilish Tricks![/h1]
Need something to stop bad little raiders dead in their tracks? Introducing Trap Doors, Spike Pits and Acid Pools! Starting next week, you’ll be able to keep unwanted intruders on their toes. Place Trap Doors anywhere in your castle, and have them drop down to either a jagged Spike Pit or a bubbling Acid Pool! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9e6f002c0801cd5d82c6578ffe2ed527017cdbe3.gif[/img]

You can even get creative and use the Trap Doors as invisible, vertical entrance points for your castle! Want to hide the real entrance to your base with a secret floor piece that you have to swim underwater to reach? Now you can! We’ll share more visuals and details on these fantastic new construction pieces next week, so stay tuned for those details soon!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/bddf12e0a66598f373c5dde437a249c3ab2940f6.jpg[/img]

[b] [u] Trap Doors, Spike Pits and Acid Pools are not time-limited, and will permanently be part of Citadel[/u] [/b] 

[h1]Much More![/h1]
We'll have event more to share outside of the Halloween content once this major update drops next week! Stay tuned for more details soon!

After next Wednesday’s update it’s time to go trick-or-treating! Every camp and cave treasure chest in the world will have a chance to drop some terrifying time-limited goodies. Some will be common, some will be less so, and some will be downright rare! The event ends [b]November 1st[/b], so make sure you grab the goodies before the chance has truly ghosted!

The most common of these temporary delights is a selection of delicious candies! Chow down on a variety of cloying sweet delights including Chocolate Kaltibur Crisps, Sweet Crowberry Gum, Chocolate Buffalo Duds and Sugar Sprite Sticks and enjoy a variety of Health Regen, Mana Regen and Movement Speed buffs!

We’re also preparing a huge selection of fun and ghoulish costumes, masks and helmets to really help you get in the spirit of the holiday! Some of these items, ridiculous though they may seem, are actually extremely viable high-end armor items – scoop them up while you can! More details on these costume items to follow in the coming week, so stay tuned!

Need something to stop bad little raiders dead in their tracks? Introducing Trap Doors, Spike Pits and Acid Pools! Starting next week, you’ll be able to keep unwanted intruders on their toes. Place Trap Doors anywhere in your castle, and have them drop down to either a jagged Spike Pit or a bubbling Acid Pool!

You can even get creative and use the Trap Doors as invisible, vertical entrance points for your castle! Want to hide the real entrance to your base with a secret floor piece that you have to swim underwater to reach? Now you can! We’ll share more visuals and details on these fantastic new construction pieces next week, so stay tuned for those details soon!
[b] [u] Trap Doors, Spike Pits and Acid Pools are not time-limited, and will permanently be part of Citadel[/u] [/b]
We'll have event more to share outside of the Halloween content once this major update drops next week! Stay tuned for more details soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/11/2017 - Reduced Marble/Ornate Costs, Various Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0faf2770b4cebe6169d02bde85dbd3c35e2e9943.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! Another Wednesday has arrived, which means it’s once again time for us to patch Citadel with some wonderful new fixes and balance changes. 

As you may remember from last week’s patch notes, we will be settling into a new patch cycle. Patches will still be released every Wednesday, but each week will alternate between minor patches and major patches. By making this change we will have more time to prepare and test new content, while at the same time having consistent stretches of time where we can evaluate and fix bugs within existing content. Today is our first minor patch, which means we are focused on evaluating changes made from last patch and applying some stability fixes.

[h1]Reduced Marble/Ornate Costs[/h1]
We heard your feedback from last week’s patch loud and clear. While our goal with raising the building cost of Marble and Ornate was to increase the perceived value of the high-tier structures and slow the appearance of massive, server straining mega-structures, we realize now that we may have gone a bit overboard in our approach.

To improve this balance change, we’re making a few significant concessions. Firstly, [b]Precious Stone has been completely removed from the recipes for Marble and Ornate Slabs[/b]. These resources were distributed quite sparingly into Ignus to give them a certain rarity, and to have them be a major component of building created for an unnecessarily tedious situation. Our second concession is to reduce the amount of slabs needed overall. [b]Slab costs for walls and floors have been reduced an additional 15-20%[/b].

[h1]Siege Spell Damage/Structure Health Rebalance[/h1]
This is a minor fix to make Siege Spell Damage and Structure Health easier to manage. [b]Both have been reduced by about 15-20%[/b]. What does this mean? Functionally, almost nothing. They've been readjusted in equal measures to make the numbers more manageable, but the number of spells it'll take to take out a wall has not changed. This is a visual/user-friendliness fix.

[h1]More Fixes/Tweaks[/h1]
Additionally, we’ve also fixed some nasty bugs to better improve the general gameplay experience. Structures have been optimized to cause less strain on both the client and server, crashes have been fixed for some players on server joins and when opening the tame menu, and we’ve fixed up a visual glitch with the top of some Marble walls clipping through floors above them. Take a look here for the complete notes:

[list][*]Curved Marble walls now properly do not clip through floors above them
[*]Optimized structure code to reduce server and client stress
[*]Reduced Slab costs for Marble and Ornate structures by 15-20% per piece
[*]Removed Precious Stone from Marble and Ornate Slab recipes
[*]Crashes fixed on joining server
[*]Crashes fixed on opening the tamed creature menu
[*]Siege Spells damage decreased
[*]Structure Health decreased[/list]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
As discussed above, next week’s patch will be a major patch. [b]We’re preparing some fun goodies to introduce our first time-limited in-game event in celebration of the Halloween season, so stay tuned for some exciting details later this week![/b] Thanks again for your support and feedback as we continue to work through Early Access, and we hope to see you in Ignus soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/4/2017 - New Castle Props & Flight Speed Increase
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/289d29bd48b28a2ba59de499b7f1cd474e14a2ff.jpg[/img]

It’s Wednesday, which means we have another patch ready to go! In addition to bug fixes and balance improvements, today’s patch will introduce another selection of lovely castle props for you to inject some decorative flair into your drab castles. From tables and chairs to beds and barrels, we’ve got just what you need to turn your hovel into a home! Take a look at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1486609767870600505]yesterday’s patch preview[/url] for full details on this wonderful new prop pack.

As we also mentioned yesterday, we’ve added a bit more to the way tame times are calculated while using Pacify. Tame times will be calculated based on a number of factors including the level of the player’s weapon, the level of the creature, debuffs that may be applied to the creature, and the creature’s current HP. We hope to give players a greater feeling of control and to make the pacification process a more engaging experience.

We’ve added a few new reagents to the game to add a little more complexity to the building system and add an extra sense of value to the higher-tier structure options. To compensate for this new step in high-level crafting, we’re decreasing the weight burden presented by raw reagents. This should make it easier for everyone to do large resource harvests without frequently having to return home and unload.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/4489ba1e52e8acc1623e206e79408b840058532e.jpg[/img]

We’ve also done another revision to the changes we made to the speed of brooms and flight potions following your feedback since our last patch. Our goal with these tweaks was to reduce the speed of these traversal options to encourage players to use the other means of their travel and experience more of the game’s world. On paper, these adjustments made sense, but a bug in our code caused an issue where all the items moved at a very similar speed. We’ve now fixed this bug, and the higher tier flight trinkets should be significantly faster. On top of that, the amount of mana they burn should also now be much less aggressive.

Take a look below for the full list of changes, and be sure to give servers a chance to update and come back up. We hope you enjoy today’s patch, and look forward to seeing you in Ignus!

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list][*]New Building Props: Tables
[*]New Building Props: Chairs
[*]New Building Prop: Bed
[*]New Building Props: Barrels
[*]New Reagent: Blue Gold Ingot
[*]New Reagent: Ornate Marble Slab
[*]New Reagent: White Marble Slab
[*]New Reagent: Flawless Rune Gem
[*]New Reagent: Enchanted Stone[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Flight trinket speeds and mana burn rates have been fixed
[*]Raw reagents have had their weight values reduced
[*]Tame times now scale based on enemy HP, weapon level and much more
[*]Fixed an error that caused the cursor to disappear on character creation
[*]Various crash fixes[/list]

[h1]Future Patch Schedule[/h1]
Following this patch, we will be slightly altering our approach to updates to increase our efficiency and improve our ability to deliver a better gameplay experience. Patches will still be released every Wednesday, but each week will alternate between minor patches and major patches.

Our goal in minor patch weeks will be to fix crashes, improve stability and fine-tune recently added content. During major patch weeks, we will focus on adding new content, upgrading gameplay systems, and rebalancing the gameplay experience. By making this change we will have more time to prepare and test new content, while at the same time having consistent stretches of time where we can evaluate and fix bugs within existing content.

We thank you for your support as we’ve worked through Early Access, and hope this change will help us deliver you the best possible Citadel experience!

notes.title: Patch Preview - New Castle Props, New Reagents & Pacify Changes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/18a149ecd973151d449149e257e93e482cb5eb54.jpg[/img]

Hello all! Tomorrow we'll be satisfying another community request by adding another set of castle props for players to fill their amazing dwellings with! Before this update, many players gave the feedback that their homes felt a little empty. We're adding a selection of basic furniture props to the game to finally breath some life into your empty dining halls and cavernous lounges!

[h1]New Building Props[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1b5f5a5fa2bfc7265ae6472385e4d29320f58388.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Tables[/u][/b]
A table is much more than a flat, elevated surface supported by four legs! Tables are a social hub! They are where people come together, where ideas are shared, and where allies are made. Grab a potion, gather ‘round your housemates, and raise your flask to friends old and new!

Or you know, maybe they are just flat, elevated surfaces supported by four legs. Either way, we have them now, and they’ll look fantastic in your castles!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c467313fda6fa8dcf19e52db428913ef80597f36.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Chairs[/u][/b]
You can’t have tables without chairs, which is why we’ve prepare two lovely seating options for your wizardly posterior! Kick up the ol’ dogs on one of two fantastic choices: On the left we have a simple wooden dining chair, and on the right we have a lovely leather padded lounger.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/8562cd16bde39911a5a575fcea48271927eed21f.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Bed[/u][/b]
Slaying the undead and taming massive dragons can be exhausting; why not build yourself a cozy, quiet space to kick back and unwind? With the upcoming addition of beds, you can finally turn your hovel into a home!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/aa0894b0fb2e455f3cdc8de27bda966d80f942ff.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Barrels[/u][/b]
We’ve also thrown in a couple barrels as additional options to give your space a little more flavor. Expect more simple props in the future to improve the aesthetic of your space!


[h1]Taming Re-balance[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/948dc741d535ac10753919501e40d99c6548f151.jpg[/img]
We'll also be applying a re-balance to taming in this upcoming patch. Historically, Pacify times were calculated in a linear fashion: The higher the creature’s level, the longer it would take to Pacify them. With our next update we’ll be adding a little more variability to the experience. 

Tame times will be calculated based on a number of factors including the level of the player’s weapon, the level of the creature, debuffs that may be applied to the creature, and the creature’s current HP. That Infernal Dragon taking too long to tame? Bring down its health, stun it with Gaslight, and pull out your strongest weapon! We hope that these new variables will make the taming of creatures a much less tedious and much more engaging experience.


[h1]New Reagents[/h1]

We'll also be adding a few new reagents to the game:
[b][u]Blue Gold Ingot[/u][/b]: 2 Gold Ore + 2 Iron Ore
[b][u]Ornate Marble Slab[/u][/b]: 2 Stone + 1 Precious Stone
[b][u]White Marble Slab[/u][/b]: 2 Stone + 1 Precious Stone
[b][u]Flawless Rune Gem[/u][/b]: 3 Rune Cystal
[b][u]Enchanted Stone[/u][/b]: 5 Stone + 5 Rune Crystal + 1 Precious Stone

These reagents will be added to the recipes for a number of building items, including magic structures, marble structural pieces and ornate structural pieces. As you can see, Precious Stone is about to get a lot more valuable, so the time to start stocking up is now!

[h1]Much More![/h1]

We'll have more info to share with you all tomorrow, including bug fixes and gameplay tweaks.Stay tuned for the full patch notes, and we'll see you in Ignus with some brand new content soon!

Tame times will be calculated based on a number of factors including the level of the player’s weapon, the level of the creature, debuffs that may be applied to the creature, and the creature’s current HP.

Good afternoon, Wizards of Ignus! We’re putting out another quick patch today to fix a bug that caused lower than normal health for some tames, and to address some feedback we received over the weekend regarding a few changes that were made in last week’s patch.

As many of you noticed, last week’s patch resulted in a decrease in speed for our various flying trinkets. notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/28/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/51aec950a62da2f872a0b17c0948aa291d82a949.gif[/img]

Hello, Wizards of Ignus! We’re finally ready to redeploy yesterday’s patch! As mentioned yesterday, this update once again is focused on refining the current Citadel experience to prepare for future content implementations.

With yesterday's patch, many NPCs became [i]tremendously[/i] overpowered. Some players even reported encountering Infernal Dragons with as much as 600,000 HP! This was clearly not intentional, and we've fixed the issue that caused this hiccup.

We’re working to have some new stuff ready to go in next week’s patch, but for today we’ll be sharing some visual improvements along with an assortment of crash fixes. 

[h1]Reformation Stone Redesign[/h1]
The Reformation Stone has been updated! Previously, it was hard to discern what your Reformation Stones were doing and when they were doing it. We’ve created a whole new set of VFX to pretty up the Reformation Stone and show specifically which pieces it’s healing. It looks pretty flashy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/007a8516bdd698e01f3ec7919e72f773668d3f1f.gif[/img]

[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
We’ve also injected another dose of UI love with this update, adding some nice new region title cards and a revamp of the loot window. These are the latest updates in or on-going beautification of the game’s UI, bringing these two parts of the interface up to the standard of the other recently updated interfaces. Expect more in the future!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1a9c1095e0ea278d4f1147ca65b5647db09d83f7.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0d113987a5a16de206551415a7b219b62b67be8c.gif[/img]

[h1]Walk Animation Improvements[/h1]
The fast paced life of a Wizard can be overwhelming. Take a moment to smell the roses with our new walking animation! Previously, we used the same animation for both running and walking, which a number of players reported as a bit disorienting. Now, when you’re not holding the run button, your character will do a distinct walking animation. 

[h1]Full Notes[/h1]
Take a look at the notes below for the full details, and make sure you give a chance for the servers to come back online. Thank you again for your support and consistent feedback, and we hope to see you in Ignus again soon!

[list][*]Reformation Stone VFX updated
[*]Players now animate differently when walking
[*]Various crash fixes related to the map menu and party/house system
[*]New regional title cards
[*]New loot window
[*]More NPC color varieties added to the world[/list]
