notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/20/2017 - Bug Fixes & Game Improvements
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/972a67a79f02009b87f6584c1d8b131a0e05cba2.jpg[/img]

Hello, Wizards of Ignus! We once again find ourselves meeting here on a Wednesday, which can only mean that it’s time for our weekly patch! As you may have heard earlier this week in our livestream, today’s patch will not be bringing any new content into Ignus. Rather, we’ve decided to focus down on bug fixing, tidying up a bunch of the community’s most frequently reported issues.

Firstly, we've made some major improvements to performance on servers with large populations and complicated structures. We'll be continuing to look into issues related to server performance degradation, but with today's patch you should hopefully notice a bump in stability.

Next up, Flight Potions will now no longer fill your vision with thick black smoke! These potions were always designed for slow, deliberate flight for precision activities such as building and navigating tight areas. To improve their functionality for these purposes, we’ve taken your feedback to heart and reduced the amount of heavy smoke that these potions emit while in-use.

We’ve also prepared a fix for Necrosis! Many members of the community have lamented the spell’s extreme damage output, requesting a re-evaluation of its balance. Upon investigation, we discovered a programmatic issue with how the spell’s damage was being handled by the game, and have resolved the issue. Necrosis should now no longer the only PVP-viable spell in your arsenal.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c28357f81150724ea6773c93411277b75bfbb447.jpg[/img]

Many players have found frustration with the Deconstructor, so we gave it a little love this week in two areas. Firstly, we've made it so the Deconstructor no longer dumps bags all over the place, and instead behaves more like the other magic structures. Secondly, we've fixed a bug that caused the Deconstructor to not work properly with stacked items. Now it will give you the full amount of resources for a stack of items, rather than behaving as if you only fed it one item.

One last major improvement we’d like to highlight here is our fix for tames disappearing on server restarts. We’ve been wrestling with this issue for a while, but we’ve finally prepared a solution that should eliminate this problem for good. No longer will you return after an update to find your precious mounts have evaporated without a trace!

There are so many fixes in this update that I’d like to highlight here – from major crash fixes and performance bumps, to magic structure upgrades and general quality of life improvements – but I think it’s best to let the patch notes speak for themselves. Take a look below at the list, and please feel free to share your feedback and thoughts on our forums! We will continue to digest everything you send us, and will use it to continue improving Citadel as we move forward on our Early Access journey!

[h1]Structures[/h1][list]
[*]Deconstructor no longer dumps bags everywhere
[*]Deconstructor works properly with stacked items
[*]Empty Magic Structures will now properly replenish mana when hooked up to a generator
[*]Can now hold ‘E’ to completely fill a Mana Generator with Rune Crystal instead of having to tap multiple times

[/list][h1]Spells[/h1][list]
[*]Necrosis’ extremely high damage has been reduced
[*]Heal Beam’s power has been significantly increased
[*]Fixed instances where Pacify could be stopped for seemingly no reason

[/list][h1]Creatures[/h1][list]
[*]Tamed creatures will now no longer disappear on server restart
[*]Fixed an issue that caused mana drain to continue when transitioning from broom to mount

[/list][h1]User Interface[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing players on Private/Custom servers to lose unlocked build menu options (This will prevent the issue from happening again, but won't fix users who are already affected. You can fix this by using admin commands to spawn in an Elixir of Amnesia and using it.)

[/list][h1]Other[/h1][list]
[*]Unequipping a Broomstick or Flight Potion now stops flight
[*]Keybindings now properly persist between game sessions
[*]Flight Potions no longer fill your vision with thick black smoke in first-person
[*]Various crash fixes
[*]Fixed issues where some players could not load into a server
[*]Server performance improvements
[*]Graphic performance improvements [/list]

notes.title: Citadel Weekly Review 9/14/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/04ec6a2f3c1fc9c4a2724934af6576589e16d07c.gif[/img]

[i]Welcome to the Weekly Review! Every Friday we’ll break down the latest happenings in the world of Citadel: Forged with Fire. Check back weekly for info on game updates, events, community content, contests and much more![/i]

[h1]New Content: Abomination[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/faf4e43841c16ef84fb77682915db9ee03f8612d.jpg[/img]

Citadel has received a gargantuan injection of nightmare fuel! The horrific Abomination - composed of gnarled, rotting flesh and inexplicable limbs, mouths and appendages - can now be found stalking the Plains and Tundra of Ignus.

Born of pure evil, the ominous return of these monstrosities signals the worrying potential for a resurgence of the dark arts in Ignus. Could this be the start of something terrifying?

[h1]New Content: Blade of Simeon's Soul[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6bd74550189b5abd99a092162bc417899a5371a8.jpg[/img]

If you want to fight the Abomination you're going to need a migthy weapon! Perhaps consider our newest melee implement: the Blade of Simeon's Soul! This high level longsword packs a mighty punch, dealing a ton of damage at a close range. You'll need to climb all the way to level 50 to unlock it, but it's well worth the effort!

[h1]Marble Contest Extension & Update[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5363424a141cf14b05e2f86e07f79595de35422e.gif[/img]

To give everyone a little extra building time we'll be extending the contest deadline to [b]Monday, September 18th[/b]. This will give everyone the full weekend to build and submit an entry to the contest. For the full contest details, see our original news post by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1440445598085278669]clicking here[/url]. Be sure to enter for your chance to win 1 of 5 Amazon Gift Cards valued up to $100!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/13/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/975a32f9ace05692ad1d501b5ba0b277ddd7a0bc.jpg[/img]

It’s Wednesday, which means we’re ready to drop another new Citadel update! Today’s patch includes some fantastic new content including a horrific new enemy and a gorgeous new high-level melee weapon. 

The Blade of Simeon's Soul is a powerful magic blade capable of delivering devastating damage to enemies, human or otherwise. Paired with buff spells like Bloodlust, this level 50 sword is capable of pushing extreme damage in a short period of time, though you will be forced to deliver it from a close range. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6bd74550189b5abd99a092162bc417899a5371a8.jpg[/img]

As mentioned above, we also have a new creature!  The Abomination is an abnormal freak of nature! As our latest high-level mob, the Abomination can be found somewhat infrequently stalking Ignus’ Plains and Tundra biomes. His immense size and duel-wielded axes make him a formidable opponent, capable of inflicting great damage very quickly. His major weakness is that he must get close, so try kiting him and using ranged weaponry. Engaging him in close combat will almost certainly be a fatal mistake.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/b49769c4d4fe99eca55094d2a4b24096c4ab9a03.jpg[/img]

The Abomination drops a set of new reagents: Sickly Hearts and Dark Plasma. While Sickly Hearts will be used in future crafting recipes, the energy of the Dark Plasma will now be a requirement in the crafting of Elixir of Demonic Spirit. It’s a good idea to hunt some of these guys down to maintain a healthy stock of reagents!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QSygtTI3mmU
Here’s the full list of changes for this week’s patch:

[list] [*]New Weapon: Blade of Simeon's Soul
[*]New Creature: Abomination
[*]New Reagents: Sickly Heart, Dark Plasma 
[*]Various fixes to holes in the world’s terrain
[*]Mature Langue Filter now defaults to on (can be turned off in Game Settings)
[*]Fixed visual quirks with various armors [/list]

As you may have read earlier this week, we’ve also gone ahead and closed a number of empty servers to better compress the community and make finding a populated server easier. If your preferred server was deleted we’ve archived and uploaded each world’s save data. [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/wm5y85k8onritnm/CitadelSavedataClosedServers.zip?dl=0]Click here[/url] if you’d like to save this data and use it on your own private server/custom game!

Just as a quick note: We are aware that some players have encountered issues with FPS drops on some servers. We are investigating this issue and will update you all as soon as we have more information!

notes.title: Patch Preview - Abomination & Blade of Simeon's Soul
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7629e5bda185d0229349d23da166aa50d739c761.gif[/img]

Brace yourselves, denizens of Ignus! We’re getting to ready another content drop tomorrow, including a powerful new addition to the melee weapon tree and a horrific new nightmare beast, The Abomination. Take a look below for a little more info!


[h1]New Weapon: Blade of Simeon's Soul[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6bd74550189b5abd99a092162bc417899a5371a8.jpg[/img]

An elegant longsword that has been enchanted with a piece of the legendary sorcerer Simeon's soul. In the right hands, the Blade of Simeon's Soul can be used to efficiently eviscerate Ignus' most intimidating adversaries.

The crafting of this powerful war blade requires a number of precious resources, including Iron and Gold Ingots, Irisite, and Dragon Stone. To unlock this legendary sword, players must reach level 50.


[h1]New Creature: Abomination[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/975a32f9ace05692ad1d501b5ba0b277ddd7a0bc.jpg[/img]

The wretched Abomination is the result of extensive dark magic experimentation conducted by the fanatical cultists of Ignus’ past. Centuries ago, these monstrosities roamed the plains and tundra freely during the peak of Ingus' dark era, but were eventually driven back and contained by the Priests of Neshan during their crusade against the dark arts.

The reemergence of these towering behemoths is quite ominous, and may signal the return of some ancient evil force. Could dark magic in Ignus be on the brink of resurgence? 


[h1]Developer Livestream[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5c190e422d9de8725fc23842c5d2c8498b1cc43c.jpg[/img]

We’ll be going live tomorrow, September 13th at 4PM Eastern Time to answer some questions and show off the new content in this week’s patch! Come hang out and join the fun at twitch.tv/playcitadel

[h1]Server Maintenance[/h1]
Notice: We'll be performing scheduled maintenance on our USEast servers and European servers on September 13th between 4am and 9am EST.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/8/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c7bfed84896f5667f13fc2f29e9520a58ff5c245.png[/img]

Hello, Wizards of Ignus! We’re putting out a quick hotfix today to supplement the patch we put out yesterday. As you may know from yesterday's patch notes, we had to hold back on two fixes. 

Wood and Stone Transmuters have had their productivity increased. Creating resources will now only require 25 mana, down from the previous requirement of 50. This should better enable players to generate larger quantities of building resources from their excess Rune Crystal.

We’re also throwing in a change to the game's decay system that wasn’t previously mentioned.  Now that we’ve significantly improved the way our servers handle the load of larger structures, we’re able to further decrease the decay rates for abandoned structures. Here’s what’s changed:

[list][*][b]Abandoned wood pieces: [/b]Increased from 5 hours to 2 days
[*][b]Abandoned stone pieces: [/b]Increased from 10 hours to 4 days
[*][b]Abandoned ornate/marble pieces: [/b]Increased from 24 hours to 1 week[/list]

Lastly, we’ve unfortunately had to put another slight delay on the fix for disappearing tames. We’ve encountered some last minute issues with the fix during testing, and want to ensure that when we do put it out it’s ready and fully functional. We apologize for the second delay, and will have it ready for another hotfix next week.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/7/2017 - Marble Structure Set
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/08aa63344a7963ee38e1009d559db66d18e8b8f2.gif[/img]

It’s patch day, which means the Marble Structure Pack is finally here! This new addition adds a full set of entirely new structure pieces to Citadel, allowing you more creative flexibility in building elaborate and complex castles! This new high level set includes pristine marble walls, floors, roofs, windows, doors and much, much more. Get to level 45, unlock the new set, and begin crafting your masterpiece!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0aQ52DUxJ6o

The fantastic Marble Set isn’t the only noteworthy thing in this week’s patch. We’ve also made a bunch of tweaks and fixes to the game to improve the gameplay experience and eliminate exploits. Storage chests now lock properly depending on if you’re in a PVP or PVE server. You can now rebind the perspective toggle button. You can also no longer use mounts to clip into someone’s base while dismounting.

One small note for today’s patch: If you saw our Patch Preview yesterday, you saw we promised a fix for the disappearing tames and a rebalance of the Stone and Wood Transmuters. notes.title: Build Contest Details & Patch Preview - Marble Castle Set
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/239183adee801dd6fe76c61d120f24850864a755.gif[/img]

[h1]Marble Build Contest[/h1]
Coming tomorrow is the first major addition to our structure system: The Marble Structure Set!  To celebrate our first new major structure system content, we'll be hosting a Marble Castle building contest. We challenge you, once the update is out, to create the most impressive Marble structure you possibly can!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/08aa63344a7963ee38e1009d559db66d18e8b8f2.gif[/img]

To enter, submit your entries in the form of screenshots or video on [url=twitter.com/playcitadel]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/playcitadelgame/]Facebook[/url] or in the new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/487120/discussions/7/]contest entry Steam sub-forum[/url]!. Contest period runs from [b]Thursday, September 7th at 12pm EST to Friday, September 15th at 12pm EST.[/b]

Five winners will be selected by popular vote among Blue Isle Studios employees and will be announced during a livestream on [b]Tuesday, September 19th at 4pm EST[/b]. Winners will receive:

[list][*][b][u]First Prize (One Winner) – $100 Amazon Gift Card[/u][/b]
[*][b][u]Second Prize (One Winner) – $75 Amazon Gift Card[/u][/b]
[*][b][u]Third Prize (Three Winners) – $25 Amazon Gift Card[/u][/b][/list]

[h1]The Marble Set[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d709cd64866943d7e57e3f8beb2557557e9832b7.gif[/img]

This new high-level set of building pieces offers a clean, palatial alternative to the brooding, gothic aesthetic of the Ornate Set. 

The Marble Set is unlocked at level 45, just like the Ornate Set, and requires the use of repurposed Stone to be built. Some of the more lavish pieces, like doors and windows, may also require the use of Iron and Gold Ingots in their construction. 

This new set offers the complete range of building pieces including walls, floors, roofs, windows, doors, stairs and much more! Not only that, but you can mix and match the pieces with the other existing sets to create appealing combinations. The Marble Set mixed with the Ornate Set, for example, provides a stunning contrast of a flat, clean white accented by shining metallic gold.

[h1]Disappearing Tames Fix[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/85b5150512663681125f4e255cc217d1a0b652cc.jpg[/img]

Many players have reported returning after updating their client to find that their precious dragons, unicorns and demons were no longer waiting for them. With tomorrow's patch, this should no longer be the case. Tamed creatures will now properly position themselves where you left them once the server went down so you can safely return to exploring and adventuring with them.

[b]UPDATE: Due to some last minute issues with the testing of this fix, we will be saving it for a hotfix to shortly follow tomorrow morning's patch. Apologies for the minor delay![/b]

[h1]Much More[/h1]
As always, there will be a few smaller tweaks and fixes in tomorrow's patch. Players can now delete their created world from within the Create Game menu, NPCs have been given a tweak to give up their chase if they fail to hit you with a certain number of attacks, and we've fixed an exploit that allowed players to dismount a tame through a base's wall. Stay tuned for full patch notes tomorrow!

notes.title: Citadel Weekly Review 9/1/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/40ab33d27578a05687e32c96a5563ec8bfcb8fb0.png[/img]

[i]Welcome to the Weekly Review! Every Friday we'll break down the latest happenings in the world of Citadel: Forged with Fire. Check back weekly for info on game updates, events, community content, contests and much more![/i]

[h1]Marble Castle Livestream[/h1]
We're happy to announce that next week will see the release of our Marble Castle Set! The clean, palacial Marble set was previewed this week on a livestream with the devs. If you missed out, you can check out the archive here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xe_YO3j1LI

[h1]Marble Castle Build Contest![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9bd680ae0642a67999c22fe09d7f4b20d2c5acc1.jpg[/img]
To celebrate next week's release, we'll be hosting a Marble Castle building contest! We challenge you, once the marble set is out, to create the most impressive, ornate structure you possibly can! Stay tuned for more details next week, and get ready to create a masterpiece!


[h1]New Content: Divine Unicorn & Tempered Iron Armor[/h1]
We added two new pieces of content in this Wednesday's patch! In case you missed our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1439318859281798792]patch preview post[/url], here are the details of what's been added:

[b][u]Divine Unicorn[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3b4a73fd9243d269364b9fd3c2c0375a9d6171a8.jpg[/img]
Long thought to be driven to extinction by the twisted dark magic that birthed its corrupted brethren, the Divine Unicorn has reemerged across Ignus. While the common Unicorns embody dark energy and corrupt magic, the Divine Unicorn is pure, and radiates with divine light. 

Like its counterparts, the Divine Unicorn is extremely uncommon. Its blood – which can be used to concot powerful potions and is used in imbuing high level magic weaponry – makes it a particularly appealing target for hunters. If you should see one, attack before it flees!

[b][u]Tempered Iron Armor[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/73a17551beefb215a081e208c66c4e503254ab27.jpg[/img]
The Tempered Iron Armor set is the next set in the Iron path of armors. Like the lower tier Iron Armor, the Tempered set is covered in dense, heavy metal plating from top to bottom, providing the wearer with a superior defense. This set possesses a high base defense stat, and will endure a heavy beating with minimal wear and tear!

No armor is perfect, and the Tempered set is no exception; this set does have a few flaws. For one, it requires a significant amount of resources to craft, which can make acquiring a full set quite the undertaking. Additionally, because of its thick, heavy nature, this set can be quite a burden. You'll want to make sure you've spent plenty of Character Points on Carrying Capacity if you'll want to wear this set with room to spare for potions, trinkets and loot!


[h1]Bug Fixes, Balance Tweaks, Optimizations[/h1]
We've put out multiple server optimization patches this week. Servers are now much better at managing and loading extreme structures, which has helped them stay up consistently and crash with significantly less frequency. 

We also fixed a serious bug with the Deconstructor, which frustrated many community members. Previously, the Deconstructor would sometimes destroy the wrong items when a player would try to engage with it. This should now be resolved. Feel free to keep all your possessions with you when breaking things down!

For a full list of changes from this week's patches, check out our patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1440444867986496322]here[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1439318859277905282]here[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1440444867991300951]here[/url]!


[h1]Trading Cards Added![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/fa752788ae22a968a4ef549c7af289402b228635.jpg[/img]
We've also added trading cards to the game! Now as you play Citadel you'll earn trading cards which can be used to unlock unique Citadel badges as well as some spiffy Steam emoticons and backgrounds!


[h1]Community Content[/h1]
Wow! What a week its been for amazing structures. You guys have truly outdone yourselves. From ornate temples to freakin' pirate ships, the community creations you guys have displayed have been mindblowing! Let's take a quick look at a few of our favorites:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1118543697]Erodiel's[/url] determined to pillage and plunder the seas surrounding Ignus with this extremely impressive pirate ship structure!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/02f76b09fbf79462ba76528d539800b7fa9d5acc.jpg[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1119402990]Mr.Huang[/url] has taken our ornate set and used it to create these impressive and extremely convincing golden temples!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/aba836f37478e5554116ea22f7a729971593c930.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5cf4333d7c04ceaba176bab047f3898227646485.jpg[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1120879442]Titanium's[/url] sprawling castle compound is wonderful! The stone walls are adorned with the ornate trim to give it a sturdy-yet-regal aesthetic.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/42dd7243e5d584714b8b1feb41c34ddb60c88c85.jpg[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1118575883]Laggytoes'[/url] kingdom is so perfectly integrated with the mountainside that it almost looks like it was meant to be there.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5eb77f53bb735244fd3dcf1c9646a89bcbc0f8c8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/31/2017 - Server Fixes & Trading Cards Added!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/31a5b90655204c2ecad93b0910464205f8db1eb9.png[/img]

[h1]Structure-Related Server Fixes[/h1]
To further improve the performance of our servers we’re putting out another quick patch. This fix should significantly improve server performance for servers that have struggled under the strain of multiple extreme and complex structures. notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/30/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/61481d726cdd824c73925614da0dca33030cd821.jpg[/img]

It’s patch day! We’re putting out another big patch today with two brand new pieces of content: The majestic Divine Unicorn and the battle-ready Tempered Iron Armor. Additionally, we’ve made a number of important bug fixes, gameplay tweaks and performance optimizations.

We’ve put together another fix for out servers that should hopefully bring some of our non-functional worlds back online. The issue is related to the extreme structure load some servers possess, and we’re working to keep up with the increasing strain. That said, this fix should do a lot of good to fix this problem, and we should have another pretty significant fix ready to address this issue later this week.

We’ve also fixed up a bug that caused the Deconstructor to destroy the incorrect items by mistake, which caused frustration for a number of players in the community. Now, any item you drop into the Deconstructor will be the item it disassembles for resources.

We’ve also made a variety of smaller fixes. UI improvements and fixes for 4:3 resolution monitors, new measures to prevent the construction of thrones and other magic structures under water, destroyed storage chests will now drop their loot in loot bags, and much more! As always, take a look below for the full notes, and we hope to see you in Ignus again soon!
 
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list][*]New Creature: Divine Unicorn
[*]New Armor: Tempered Iron Armor[/list]

[h1]Structures[/h1]
[list][*]Heal Beam once again works properly on structure pieces
[*]Deconstructor will now correctly destroy the intended items
[*]Destroyed storage chests now drop loot bags
[*]Can no longer build magic structures underwater
[*]IAdjusted Transmuter/Rune Recycler mana usage and output to prevent an extreme resource generation exploit
[*]Increased damage on attack tower magic structures[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list][*]Further fixes for menus on 4:3 displays
[*]New World Create screen
[*]Server Name now appears in-game
[*]Mount button removed for unmountable creatures[/list]

[h1]Other Optimizations, Tweaks & Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Server structure improvements to bring non-functional servers back up
[*]Reduced concentration of rare enemies in some areas
[*]Fixed Elixir of Amnesia not removing equipped spells
[*]Patched up spots that allowed building under the terrain[/list]

notes.title: Patch Preview - Divine Unicorn, Tempered Iron Armor & Marble Set Livestream
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/85b5150512663681125f4e255cc217d1a0b652cc.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Wizards! Thanks to your fantastic support and feedback we have another big update coming tomorrow with some new content, gameplay balance tweaks, and bunch of  important bug fixes. Take a look below for details on what you can expect tomorrow!

[h1]Divine Unicorn[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3b4a73fd9243d269364b9fd3c2c0375a9d6171a8.jpg[/img]

Long thought to be driven to extinction by the twisted dark magic that birthed its corrupted brethren, the Divine Unicorn has reemerged across Ignus. While the common Unicorns embody dark energy and corrupt magic, the Divine Unicorn is pure, and radiates with divine light. 

Like its counterparts, the Divine Unicorn is extremely uncommon. Its blood – which can be used to concot powerful potions and is used in imbuing high level magic weaponry – makes it a particularly appealing target for hunters. If you should see one, attack before it flees!

[h1]Tempered Iron Armor[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/73a17551beefb215a081e208c66c4e503254ab27.jpg[/img]

The Tempered Iron Armor set is the next set in the Iron path of armors. Like the lower tier Iron Armor, the Tempered set is covered in dense, heavy metal plating from top to bottom, providing the wearer with a superior defense. This set possesses a high base defense stat, and will endure a heavy beating with minimal wear and tear!

No armor is perfect, and the Tempered set is no exception; this set does have a few flaws. For one, it requires a significant amount of resources to craft, which can make acquiring a full set quite the undertaking. Additionally, because of its thick, heavy nature, this set can be quite a burden. You’ll want to make sure you’ve spent plenty of Character Points on Carrying Capacity if you’ll want to wear this set with room to spare for potions, trinkets and loot!

[h1]Various Fixes and Tweaks[/h1]
As always, we'll be making many smaller fixes and tweaks to improve the game experience. Some noteworthy fixes:
[list][*]Servers will again be given more optimization to ensure they stay up longer and can better manage the load of extreme structures. 
[*]The heal beam will once again work as intended to repair damage structure pieces. 
[*]The Deconstructor will now destroy the correct items.
[*] Increased damage for defensive towers[/list]

And much more! Stay tuned for the full details tomorrow!

[h1]Marble Set Livestream[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f454e7279962d3599f223e60679b873d84a04d04.jpg[/img]

Our Marble Set is still a few weeks away, but you can join us for a sneak peek tomorrow at 4PM Eastern Time to see a live build of a full Marble Castle! We'll take your suggestions for where we should build it and what it should look like, as well as answering your Marble related questions, so come hang out in chat and share your thoughts, feedback and queries! twitch.tv/playcitadel

notes.title: Citadel Weekly Review 8/25/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/b419202771af34b1e6fc7aafda549f54ab7530ae.jpg[/img]

[i]Welcome to the Weekly Review! Every Friday we’ll break down the latest happenings in the world of Citadel: Forged with Fire. Check back weekly for info on game updates, events, community content, contests and much more![/i]

[h1]Patches: Siege Spell Rebalances, Bug Fixes, and Other Changes[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/18e98c3a1e1d24f53bc0effe04a40d49e18c8f2f.gif[/img]

Last week we added a new system to the game’s raiding dynamic: Siege Spells. These spells are the only ones capable of damaging structures, and can only be cast with the aid of hard-to-craft elixirs. The goal of this new system is to curb rampant griefing and encourage players to make more meaningful choices with regards to who they choose to raid.

Since their addition, we’ve received and digested a ton of feedback from the community about Siege Spells. As a result we’ve made a few adjustments to one particular Siege Spell – Divine Bomb – as well as the unlock progression of Siege Spells in general. Check out our patch notes for the full details.

We’ve also made a few smaller changes to improve the quality of life experience for everyone. No-build zones have been added above Fast Travel towers to prevent players from completely sealing them off, we’ve implemented a fix to ensure that Mana Generator energy does not clear out when a server restarts, and added a new system to allow players to see which servers they have characters saved on.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1439318334285677109]Click here[/url] to read all about these new changes.

[h1]Developer Q&A Livestream [/h1]
We had another livestream this week where we answered questions and talked about the current status of the game. Check out the archive below if you’d like to hear us discuss the status of things like major boss battles, structure piece upgrading, dynamic weather and much, much more!
https://youtu.be/gyRgMqTsZwA?t=5m55s
 [h1]Community Content[/h1]
You guys have been very productive this week! Some of the intricate structures you’ve shared with us on Steam, the community Discord and Twitter are mindblowing, and we’d like to take a moment to highlight a few. From pyramids to massive cathedrals to towers that stretch miles into the sky, here are our top picks of this week’s creative works:

Lysaria built this absolutely stunning “College of Mages” complete with improvised chandeliers. Really creative use of the ornate fringe pieces!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/bf18b0317539d652a8d5a39446d9a485b7a31bab.jpg[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1116139221]Narfsrin[/url], in collaboration with some friends, built an amazing city, with a giant Mayan-esque pyramid as the center piece.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/093b7b84649e24806c584360d4398d0b13226617.jpg[/img]

[url=https://twitter.com/Thunderwaffles/status/901071308678586368]Jake Waffles[/url] has built quite the fortified palace! Check out those magic defenses.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9586501c1a3a96d90d7b013c2d45f3abeb4451dd.jpg[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1111210581]Unicorn Goddess’s[/url] Multi-tied castle is particularly impressive. We love the way each layer naturally rests within the slope of the mountain side. Great placement of banners, too!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3dd536f7168a0951565aa84a8b5afb7a383f8fd8.jpg[/img]

[url=https://twitter.com/Xeirus/status/900535652923691010]Josh Ⓥ[/url] is back this week, this time with an amazing spiral tower! I can’t imagine how imposing this thing must be when stumbled upon unexpectedly!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/be1c38e099716789bfbf11f7ff4ec31d7a02a061.png[/img]

[url=https://twitter.com/Audiosenpai]AudioSenpai[/url] is building a complex city comprised of sprawling, interconnected ornate structures. Definitely worth a look if you’re in [url=https://discord.gg/JAVjg46]the community Discord![/url]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ba89dd5024897f619f81e58360196c6680b52d56.jpg[/img]

[h1]Upcoming Content[/h1]
[b][u]Divine Unicorn[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3b4a73fd9243d269364b9fd3c2c0375a9d6171a8.jpg[/img]
We’ll be back to adding new content in next Wednesday’s patch. Here’s a quick little look one major piece: the Divine Unicorn! Many people love the style of our dark, corrupted Unicorn, but were also hoping to see something a little lighter and more traditional. This graceful, elegant beast will begin roaming Ignus next week, but expect it to be just as rare as our other Unicorn.

[b][u]Marble Structure Set[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/2c6d096cb19b2e953f1f3ac91da47de887bbfc16.jpg[/img]
If you caught our Livestream last week then you probably saw this little preview for the Marble Structure Set. This set is intended to be the counterpoint to the Ornate Set. While that set exudes a dark, metallic, gothic feel, this new set is focused on being a lighter and cleaner looking option for high level players. This one won’t be in next week’s patch, but it’s getting close to completion and should be available very, very soon!

This one won’t be in next week’s patch, but it’s getting close to completion and should be available very, very soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/23/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ccbeac221cf810cbd077a85c31cac3a5e6ce2acc.gif[/img]

We’re ready to deploy this week’s Wednesday update! This week will be mostly focused on some rebalancing of our Siege Spells based on your feedback since their implementation last week. We’ve made them easier to get at earlier levels, and have made the Divine Bomb a little less abusable by making its recipe harder and reducing the size of its AOE. You can read more about those changes in yesterday’s [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/2631646319060673583]Patch Preview.[/url].

We’ve also made a number of smaller quality-of-life changes. No-build zones have been added above Fast Travel towers to prevent players from completely sealing them, we’ve implemented a fix to ensure that Mana Generator energy does not clear out when a server restarts, and we’ve added some additional little love to the server browser.

As you may have noticed, this week’s patch contains no new content, as everything we’re currently working on needs a little more time in the oven. We're still hard at work on new creatures, weapons, armors, spells and gameplay features for the game, and will be back to adding new goodies next week. Stay tuned for details soon!

[b][u]Here’s the complete changelist for today’s patch:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Divine bomb AOE radius decreased
[*]Elixir of Divine Being recipe now requires 6 Phoenix Feathers
[*]Arcane Bomb moved to level 15
[*]Divine Bomb moved to level 30
[*]Celestial Bomb moved to level 45
[*]Added a no-build zone above fast-travel towers
[*]Increased Reformation Stone Healing
[*]Fixed Divine Orb damage output
[*]Server browser now shows which servers you have a character saved on
[*]Mana Generators now properly persist Rune Crystals on server restarts

notes.title: Patch Preview - Siege Spell Rebalances
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/98e01c864b148bab5b633f82bbc9303406e58a46.jpg[/img]

Good afternoon, fellow Wizards! As always, we’ll be putting out our weekly patch tomorrow with the usual selection of bug fixes and balance tweaks. Today’s patch preview will be a little more focused as we talk about incoming changes to the recently implemented Siege Spells.

[h1]Siege Spell Rebalances[/h1]
We’ve been observing the reactions to our new Siege Spells closely, and have absorbed a great deal of feedback from the community. While a lot of the feedback has been positive, many people have pointed out places where the current balance may need some readjustment. This week we’ll be making our first balance changes to further improve the dynamic:

[b][u]Siege Spell Unlock Adjustment[/u][/b]
One of the first thing’s we’ll be tweaking is the current level at which players can access their first Siege Spell. Many pointed out that level 35 is a bit extreme, and may not give lower level players the ability to retaliate should they find themselves the target of a raid. To remedy this, we’ve shifted the levels a bit:[list]
[*]Arcane Bomb will now be unlocked at level 15
[*]Divine Bomb will now be unlocked at level 30
[*]Celestial Bomb will now be unlocked at level 45[/list]

[b][u]Divine Bomb Nerf[/u][/b]
Additionally, [i]Divine Bomb[/i] will be receiving a bit of a nerf. We’ve seen a lot of feedback suggesting that this spell is both too strong, and too easy to acquire. To combat this, we’ve made its AOE range significantly smaller to prevent it from causing massive damage to large chunks of a structure. Additionally, we’re increasing the number of Phoenix Feathers require to craft it from 4 to 6. 

[h1]More Fixes and Balance Changes[/h1]
We'll detail the various fixes and balance changes tomorrow in our full patch notes, so stay tuned and check back tomorrow!

[h1]Developer Livestream[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3987f293cde364c81a37cc69824701315026d2df.jpg[/img]

Lastly, be sure to come hang out with us this Wednesday while we play some Citadel and answer your questions! We'll run down the new content we've recently added, talk about some things we have in the works, and answer chat questions.

Follow us at http://twitch.tv/playcitadel

notes.title: Citadel Weekly Review 8/18/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f73ae1df7a1629dca821adec05a7954707dbc54a.jpg[/img]
[i] Welcome to the Weekly Review! Every Friday we’ll break down the latest happenings in the world of Citadel: Forged with Fire. Check back weekly for info on game updates, events, community content, contests and much more![/i]

[h1]Patches - Server Fixes, Magic Find Improvements, The Phoenix & More[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/05a1b6967649f4172c2cf3d2395b98f7b34e4eb6.gif[/img]

This week’s big patch added a ton of important quality of life changes like UI improvements, magic property fixes, corpse markers and much more! We also added a new piece of content: the fiery Phoenix, who plays an important role in our redesigned Siege system (more on that later).

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438191800261333340]Click here[/url] to read about the big Wednesday update.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PcbLR6AYsPs
We also put out two small patches to alleviate some of the server crashes experience by a few of our more popular servers. We’ve made it so that these servers can stay up longer before they crash, and we’re working hard on soon having a solution that should eliminate this problem for good. 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/2631645796707981494]Click here[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438191674103045886]here[/url] to read about these server crash fixes.

[h1]Siege Improvements [/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/18e98c3a1e1d24f53bc0effe04a40d49e18c8f2f.gif[/img]

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve been able to implement one of our first major improvements to Citadel’s siege dynamic to make it more meaningful and less griefable. We’ve moved away from free, open raiding to a more controlled system where players are required to use specific siege spells that can only be cast with the aid of potent elixirs. These elixirs require a bit of a time investment to craft, requiring rare resources like Unicorn Blood, Phoenix Feathers and Fiery Essence.

Previously, a level 60 player could essentially fly around and steamroll an entire server in the span of a couple hours. Clearly, this is only fun for one person. By adding a bit of a labor barrier to raiding, players must now think carefully about who they want to siege. 

Additionally, it’s also much, much harder to completely destroy someone’s hard work. With open raiding, a griefer could easily wipe someone’s massive castle clean off the map with enough patience. This new system now incentivizes players to simply punch a couple holes in your wall, steal your loot, and leave.

We’ll be watching your feedback on this new system, and will be altering its balance and fleshing it out as we move forward through Early Access.

[h1]Community Content[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1110897081]Keksfee[/url] has created this absolutely mindblowing network of stone pyramids.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/afc4470661964b05e994481e560f2aa88e27356c.jpg[/img]

[url=https://twitter.com/Xeirus/status/898016141842493440]Josh Ⓥ[/url] on Twitter has created this fantastic ornate castle on his Divine Sanction private server.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/efcdffc4da9df498286398292777eb83bf8e8264.jpg[/img]

Gamespot hopped into the game to fight an Infernal Dragon, build some cool structures, and take a little tour of Ignus. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KUWEsLF9TTU
Raterro on YouTube has made a hugely impressive Ice Mountain Castle, complete with defensive turrets and dragon guards!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oVfS3eNXq84
Blindwood’s Ignus Arena is designed perfectly for an epic PVP battle.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V4G0h6C_23w

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/16/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/18e98c3a1e1d24f53bc0effe04a40d49e18c8f2f.gif[/img]

Today is Wednesday, and Wednesday means patch day! The team has been hard at work on today’s update, which includes some pretty significant new systems and content. Yesterday we wrote about Siege Spells, Corpse Markers, New UI Improvements and the brand-new Phoenix enemy. You can [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438191674106989223]click here[/url] to check that out now!

The complexity and size of the buildings that you guys have constructed has been far beyond anything we imagined! Because of the immensity of these structures, we’ve been able to identify an engine-level issue with how physics objects are handled by PhysX. This issue has contributed to the lack of stability that has burdened some servers, particularly our European servers. We’ve implemented a fix that should alleviate some of these issues and keep our Euro servers up longer! Server stability is, as it always will be, an on-going priority for us, so please let us know if your server of choice continues to struggle after today’s update.

Additionally, magical properties will now generate correctly on crafted items, weapons and armors. We found that our Magic Find system was not configured properly, causing these enchantments to appear significantly less frequently than we intended. This should now be fixed!

Lastly, we’ve fixed the way the Elixir of Amnesia works on private servers with XP multipliers. The Elixir works by reducing your level to 0 and then immediately giving you the XP you need to return to your previous level. This process is now immune to XP multiplication.


[b][u]Here’s the complete changelist for today’s patch:[/u][/b]

[h1]New Content[/h1][list]
[*]New creature: Phoenix
[*]New reagent: Phoenix Feathers
[*]Siege spells added: Celestial Bomb, Arcane Bomb, Divine Bomb[/list]

[h1]Structures[/h1][list]
[*]Structures are now only vulnerable to Siege spells[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1][list]
[*]Improved tame menu
[*]Improved death screen
[*]Improved build menu
[*]Corpse markers added to map on death
[*]Corpse markers turn grey if player's loot bag despawns or is taken[/list]

[h1]Crafting[/h1][list]
[*]Crafted items will now have a chance of having multiple magic properties
[*]Elixir of Amnesia now works properly on servers with XP multipliers[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1][list]
[*]Server optimizations
[*]Player dropped loot bags now stick around for 15 minutes[/list]

Please be sure to update your client via Steam, and give our servers a moment to come back online with the latest version of Citadel. As always, we hope to see you in Ignus!

Because of the immensity of these structures, we’ve been able to identify an engine-level issue with how physics objects are handled by PhysX. This issue has contributed to the lack of stability that has burdened some servers, particularly our European servers. We’ve implemented a fix that should alleviate some of these issues and keep our Euro servers up longer! Server stability is, as it always will be, an on-going priority for us, so please let us know if your server of choice continues to struggle after today’s update.

Additionally, magical properties will now generate correctly on crafted items, weapons and armors. We found that our Magic Find system was not configured properly, causing these enchantments to appear significantly less frequently than we intended. This should now be fixed!

Lastly, we’ve fixed the way the Elixir of Amnesia works on private servers with XP multipliers. The Elixir works by reducing your level to 0 and then immediately giving you the XP you need to return to your previous level. This process is now immune to XP multiplication.


[b][u]Here’s the complete changelist for today’s patch:[/u][/b]

[h1]New Content[/h1][list]
[*]New creature: Phoenix
[*]New reagent: Phoenix Feathers
[*]Siege spells added: Celestial Bomb, Arcane Bomb, Divine Bomb[/list]

[h1]Structures[/h1][list]
[*]Structures are now only vulnerable to Siege spells[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1][list]
[*]Improved tame menu
[*]Improved death screen
[*]Improved build menu
[*]Corpse markers added to map on death
[*]Corpse markers turn grey if player's loot bag despawns or is taken[/list]

[h1]Crafting[/h1][list]
[*]Crafted items will now have a chance of having multiple magic properties
[*]Elixir of Amnesia now works properly on servers with XP multipliers[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1][list]
[*]Server optimizations
[*]Player dropped loot bags now stick around for 15 minutes[/list]

Please be sure to update your client via Steam, and give our servers a moment to come back online with the latest version of Citadel. As always, we hope to see you in Ignus!

notes.title: Patch Preview - Phoenix, Siege Spells, Corpse Marker & More!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e399918a23ec8f3dda6cdc7ac3baca1398035346.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Wizards! Thanks to your fantastic support and feedback we have another big update for tomorrow featuring hotly requested gameplay changes, balance adjustments and even a new creature! Raiding is being improved, things like corpse markers have been added to make your life a little easier, and the game’s UI is getting another dose of polish. As always, please continue to share your feedback with us here on Steam, on Twitter and through our support email!

[b]Here’s what’s coming tomorrow:[/b]

[h1]Phoenix[/h1]
We’re adding another new creature to Ignus’ bestiary: the legendary Phoenix. A mythical creature born of flame and ancient magic, the fiery Phoenix is an extremely rare specimen. Reported sightings are few and far between, with no consistent time or location amongst them to help narrow the search.

Hunting the Phoenix will take patience and determination, but the rewards are worth it. Not only do they drop quality loot, but their feathers are necessary in the crafting of powerful siege magic elixirs.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/05a1b6967649f4172c2cf3d2395b98f7b34e4eb6.gif[/img]


[h1]Siege Spells[/h1]
Our existing raiding dynamic needed some work. The way our RPG character progression worked in parallel to a system of structure sieging was not working in a way we’d hoped. It encouraged the griefing of defenseless low-level players rather than fostering meaningful raiding between powerful players. 

To improve this, we’ll be introducing a series of spells specifically intended for raiding. These will be the only spells capable of destroying structure pieces, and will only be used by crafting extremely expensive consumable elixirs. By doing this, raiders will now be encouraged to target players they actually stand to gain something from, rather than targeting low level players who are just starting to learn the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f4d6c9d15e71fdfe85a6d5e30651db82c6474e3d.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/47abd4aa565de2e7574a61303490355fc054bcf8.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7bbd90b0757f304d16b023f4452641da897779a5.jpg[/img]


[h1]Corpse Marker[/h1]
Tired of stumbling through the Tundra, aimlessly looking for your dropped loot after you’ve died? Us too! That’s why we’ve taken your feedback to heart and updated our existing map system to support a corpse marker. Now, when you die, a marker will be left on the map to track where it happened. This marker will even change color if your loot is picked up or despawns, so you’ll know when it’s worth your effort to make the trek.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/099b1ed478d56baf8105077f199191418ff876ec.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Tame UI[/h1]
Hot on the heels of our HUD update, we’ve added some more polish to the overall presentation of our in-game UI. The tame menu, for example, has been given a bunch of love. In addition to just looking much slicker, it also resolves the pesky issue of having the button to mount a creature right beside the button to free them. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c6e09839c574a07cee2757cc411c6b47d5dfcaf7.png[/img]


[h1]New Build UI[/h1]
We’re also giving our building menu some love to bring it up to the standard set by our previous UI changes. We’ve shifted everything over to the side to give you a clearer view of your health and mana while you’re building, and have made it easier to see the resource costs associated with each building piece.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/469f38233bc7dd7f17b3643bd79cd48e15ba26a2.png[/img]


[h1]New Death Screen[/h1]
Lastly, we’ve updated the death screen. Functionally it’s pretty much the same but, man, does it ever look way cooler! Take a look for yourself!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d3122d05946bf2251d756ff2f2974c926fbab64d.gif[/img]


[h1]Much More[/h1]
As always, we have a ton more tweaks, fixes and improvements coming with tomorrow’s patch. For the full details, check out complete patch notes here on Steam tomorrow. Thanks again for your support and feedback, and we hope to see you in Ignus!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/470fefb8332e9b32360d99ee347b02473e936a07.jpg[/img]


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
We’re pushing out one last small patch this week ahead of the weekend. This patch will hopefully put an end to an issue we’ve been working hard on fixing for a while now: non-responsive AI.

As some of you may have encountered, there have been circumstances where AI will not respond to player presence or attacks. Try as you might to change their behavior, enemies would continue walking on their merry way. This should no longer be the case after this update.

Once you’ve updated your clients, and the servers have returned, this should hopefully be resolved. Private server owners should also make sure their server is updated to get the fix on their custom games.


[h1]New Ornamental Structure Pieces, UI Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h1]
We deployed another big patch on Wednesday to add a series of ornamental structure piece options to the game, including paintings, rugs, lighting options and statues. We’ve even added bookshelves and door-variant bookshelves so you can add secret rooms to your castles!

We also updated our server browser functionality, made our in-game HUD a little cleaner, pumped out some new crash fixes, and increased our structure decay times! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9a9678cba2be1b44c838c6b5ee68cfe0270a85ba.gif[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438191146264612695]Click here[/url] to read all the details of our Wednesday patch!


[h1]Coming Next Week[/h1]
Next Wednesday’s patch will bring some hotly desired features. In addition to some new creatures specifically requested by the community, as well as magic find improvements, we’re also adding a few quality of life items like corpse markers on the map and full rebinding of WASD. Take a look at the image above for a sneak peek, and stay tuned for new details next week!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/9/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/80016e6a9e3476d419443926f46d26d8e677236e.jpg[/img]

It’s Wednesday, which means we have another patch ready to go! Today’s patch will address a number of lingering issues while at the same time adding a selection of new decorative structure options. For more info on these new building options check out our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438191146260448531]patch preview post.[/url]

As mentioned in our patch preview, we’ve made significant improvements to our server browser. Servers can now be filtered and sorted in a variety of ways, making it easier for you to the exact game that meets your needs. Want to only see official European servers, and have them ordered by player count? Trying to find the lowest possible ping? The server browser update has you covered.

We’ve also made significant improvements to the in-game UI to reduce screen clutter and make things a little cleaner. Health and Mana bars, for example, have been moved below your hotkeys to keep all essential information centered in one convenient area.

We’ve also heard plenty of commentary about our current decay model for throned structures. Before this patch, a throne would completely decay after 10 days if not properly maintained. In response to the community’s feedback, we’re bumping that up to 16 days. This will help make maintaining your structure a bit less of a chore.

As always, this update includes a bunch of crash fixes, including a frequently reported crash that occurs when equipping various armors, especially the new Iron set. Take a look at the complete list of changes below!

(NOTE: Our USWest servers will be down on August 10th between 3am and 5am pst for hardware upgrades)

[h1]Structures[/h1][list]
[*]HP values fixed on doors and a few other functional structure pieces
[*]Throne decay time increased from 10 days to 16 days
[*]Rugs added
[*]Paintings added
[*]Lighting options added
[*]Statues added
[*]Bookshelves added[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1][list]
[*]In-game HUD cleaned up and redesigned
[*]Sort by name added to server browser
[*]Sort by PVP/PVE added to server browser
[*]Sort by number of players added to server browser
[*]Sort by region added to server browser
[*]Sort by ping added to server browser
[*]Filter full/empty servers added to server browser
[*]Filter official/custom servers added to server browser
[*]Filter by region added to server browser
[*]Stop button added to server browser[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1][list]
[*]Various crash fixes, including crashes related to equipping some armors
[*]Fixed some NPCs dropping the wrong loot
[*]Infernal Dragon, Skeleton Warrior and Boar now drop loot
[*]Patched up a number of map exploits to prevent building under the terrain[/list]

notes.title: Patch Preview - Ornamental Structure Pack
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9a9678cba2be1b44c838c6b5ee68cfe0270a85ba.gif[/img]

Time for another patch preview! Tomorrow we'll be adding a ton of new ornamental structure options to give you more ways to make your castles feel cozier and lived in. We've got new rugs, paintings, statues and lighting options, and we've even added a new way for players to add secret rooms to their fortress. Take a look at what's coming in tomorrow's update!

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/30e18ff9207cfb7b793788af26c07e91be95105c.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Rugs[/u][/b]
Is your castle starting to feel a little drab? Looking for something to really tie the room together? Try one of our three new ornamental rugs! Each rug can give your rooms an entirely new aesthetic: get that quaint, cozy feeling from a simple area rug, or roll out the red carpet and indulge in complete regal elegance.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e47d6c853cad600052b8d6c876300a241fbcae34.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Paintings[/u][/b]
Add some color to your life and show the neighbors how cultured you are with a series of beautiful new paintings. From sweeping landscapes to terrifying beasts, each serves wonderfully as a conversation starter: Who is that Orc? What is he thinking? Did he really pose for hours to have his portrait painted?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/80016e6a9e3476d419443926f46d26d8e677236e.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Statues[/u][/b]
Remind nature who’s boss with our first three statues: Direwolf, Wild Elk and Bear! Source the materials needed to mount these ferocious beasts by hunting for pelts and gathering cloth and metal to reinforce them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e5684b7f9ec235e3e45acd1cb2d015d1da412a44.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Bookshelf/Bookshelf Door[/u][/b]
You wanted secret rooms, you got secret rooms! We’re adding both basic and door-variant bookshelves to Citadel to allow you to add a little mystery to the structures you build. Hide a secret treasure room or basement dungeon by mixing a bookshelf door in with basic bookshelves.

[b][u]Browser Improvements[/u][/b]
We’ve added a lot of improvements to the server browser to make finding the servers you want to play quicker and easier. You can now properly sort by server name, server type, number of players, region and ping, and can even filter to hide or show official servers, custom servers, empty servers and full servers.

[b][u]Fixes and Balance Improvements[/u][/b]
We’ll also have a bunch of other small things to share with you tomorrow. Camera smoothing has been added to the options menu, Skeleton Warriors and Boars now properly drop loot, lots of little UI improvements, crash fixes and much more. Stay tuned for the full changelist tomorrow!

notes.title: Citadel Weekly Review 8/4/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7bd9f056981bba1b40127ca5dfff40b3dcae52ff.jpg[/img]

[i]Welcome to the Weekly Review! Every Friday we’ll break down the latest happenings in the world of Citadel: Forged with Fire. Check back weekly for info on game updates, events, community content, contests and much more![/i]


[h1]Discussing Citadel’s Future[/h1]
We’ve had an exciting first week of citadel, and are super excited to press onward into the weeks of Early Access to come. A lot of players have asked about where we hope to take Citadel over the next few months. To that end, yesterday we shared with you some of our ideas for the future of Citadel. We want to work transparently with the community to deliver content that most appeals to our audience, and we believe this board is a great way for us to show you where our head is as the game moves forward.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/2645a43c7dda24cac7da3d8dcb96714a1e487abb.png[/img]

We also invite you to look at these features and express your interest in them by using Trello’s “vote” functions. New features will be prioritized by a combination of fan enthusiasm and developer resources, so be sure to take a look and let us know which ones stand out to you the most!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438190618780833080]Click here[/url] to read the big post and view the Trello board.


 [h1]Bug Fixes, Optimizations & New Content [/h1]
Our first big patch went out this Wednesday, and with it came some incredible new monsters and a ton of bug fixes and balance tweaks. The Infernal Dragon now terrorizes players in the high level areas, Telekinesis was nerfed to reduce griefing, and some small things like mouse sensitivity have been added based on player feedback. Take a look at the new creature trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E4f982DMDQI

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/487120/announcements/detail/1438190618776966403]Click here[/url] to read the finer details of our big patch


 [h1]Community Content[/h1]
You guys continue to absolutely floor us with your fantastic creations! Some really amazing structures have popped up over the last week. Here’s a few that caught our eye:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1093539235]Just Horse[/url] created this perfect recreation of Isengard’s striking tower.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/8dc7ee06404f6c704fe4a28447131863d28eccff.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ForgedWithFire/comments/6rdk1x/finished_my_throne_room/]Master Builder Zagwitz[/url] has once again blown us away with this impressive structure work.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/11ad2493dbae3ddbb2d5f6f4ef66e96a52bf9090.png[/img]

[url=https://twitter.com/ractgaming]Reaction Gaming[/url] built a massive fortress with a custom PVP arena. You can check it out on his server Reaction TR!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/95c3213bde7d57c70601bf50d701295f024129dd.png[/img]

Flashdim has built a cool complex of interconnected buildings.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1a513e0ff60f8b1722bdd2f574fac4f5cab69fd2.png[/img]

Ser Winter’s Castle Dragonberg is downright mind-blowing.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pnOIeT-9gVQ
SHADOWFRAX takes his first steps in Ignus and gets to know the neighbors.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WdDzfK4Ahjo

[h1]Coming Next Week[/h1]
We’ve got another content drop coming next week! Here’s a small teaser of what you can expect to see…

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/2295fbc42f18ac8991136ea0d050edf722f6c582.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/4/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/96e0ebb9f9cf7362bcddf12ebc9ad86c32c7ba99.png[/img]

Good afternoon, Wizards! 

We’re putting out a quick patch today to eliminate a few more bugs before we head into the weekend. In addition to some key bug fixes, we’ve also cleaned up a few issues that would cause some servers to become non-functional. USEast8, a server many of you frequent, should now be back in operation.

Take a look below, make sure you update your client, and give the servers a moment to come back up with the most recent version.

[list][*]Fixed a VOIP-related issue that caused CPU lag for AMD users
[*]Fixed a bug where some players couldn't join the game after playing a character for a while
[*]Fixed a bug where spell cooldowns would sometimes not reset after a server restart
[*]Fixed a bug where level 58 -> 59 required 9 million XP instead of 900k (for real this time)
[*]Fixed an issue with Mana Generators and powered structures that caused USEast8 to go down
[*]Improved performance with Mana Generators and powered structures
[*]Fixed a server crash related to NPCs[/list]

notes.title: Discussing Citadel's Future
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9e3ed47b2c2e153cac7515839aa24850a958aae4.jpg[/img]

We’ve just wrapped up our first week of Early Access, and already we’re seeing a massive outpouring of ideas & suggestions for the future of the game! Clearly, the community has big ideas about where the game should be heading, and we’ve been listening and taking notes.

In the spirit of transparency and collaboration, we’ve assembled a publically accessible Trello board that lists ideas for the future of the game based on what we’ve seen suggested by the community and that we’ve come up with internally. As we begin work on a feature, it will be moved over to the “In Progress” section. This will allow you to clearly follow along as we work through new content for the game. 

Check it out here: https://trello.com/b/McOUEdRk/citadel-forged-with-fire-early-access-idea-board

Each tag has a “Vote” option, which you can use to express your interest in that particular feature:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0c9ed06374946f849617694c7db4d446fd6350e1.png[/img]

[b](Please note that not every feature on this board is guaranteed to make it into the game, nor is there any guarantee that the most voted for items will be worked on next. We prioritize things based on a combination of community enthusiasm and available developer resources)[/b]

Below is a simple breakdown of some of the things on the board. Please feel free to let us know which ones really excite you (the best way being via the vote function), or share new ideas of your own. We’ll be listening and adding things periodically!


[h1]Idea Board Content[/h1]

[b][u]Bug Fixes & Performance Optimization[/u][/b] - Improving optimization and fixing bugs will be an ongoing top priority for us during all phases of the Early Access process.

[b][u]Mod Support/Custom Map Support[/u][/b] - We’d like to allow players the freedom to create their own mods, maps and game modes, and enable them to share their creations via Steam Workshop.

[b][u]World Bosses[/u][/b] - Large, powerful end-game threats that can only be challenged by groups of players at extremely high levels. 

[b][u]World Events[/u][/b] - Randomly occurring events in the game world, like dangerous enemies and  valuable treasures spawning in broadcasted areas, that prompt player action.

[b][u]Broomstick League[/u][/b] - A competitive broomstick-based sporting diversion players can use to challenge each other in a fun, lighthearted way.

[b][u]Dueling System[/u][/b] - A system where two players could consensually agree to a friendly duel. Rather than fight to the death, they would fight until one person is reduced to a minimum amount of HP. 

[b][u]PVP Hotspots[/u][/b] - Nodes, towers, arenas or any other system to create areas on the map that make PVP fighting more attractive.

[b][u]Player Made Quests[/u][/b] - A system whereby players could create their own quests for other players to complete.

[b][u]Player/House Reputation System[/u][/b] - A system to track players who engage in frequent PKing. At a certain point they may receive some kind of mark and increased visibility.

[b][u]Improved Raiding Dynamic[/u][/b] - We’d like to improve raiding by making structures vulnerable only to specific siege spells. These spells can only be cast with the possession of a difficult to acquire item.

[b][u]Dynamic Weather System[/u][/b] - The possibility of interesting weather conditions dynamically occurring in the game world, with potential implications on gameplay.

[b][u]NPC Stores[/u][/b] - NPC stores in the three starter towns where players can buy and sell gear they’ve crafted or looted.

[b][u]Trading System[/u][/b] - A centralized place in-game where players can list items and sell them to other players asynchronously.

[b][u]Dye System[/u][/b] - A system whereby players can dye their armor/clothing different colors for an added level of appearance customizability. 

[b][u]Creature Possession[/u][/b] - The ability to use a spell to possess a tamed creature and directly control them for a short period of time.

[b][u]Cooking[/u][/b] - Use natural ingredients from the world to cook a variety of dishes. Cooked meals will provide time-limited buffs when consumed.

[b][u]Underwater Overhaul[/u][/b] - We’d love to add more creatures and points of interests to our underwater areas, and add items that allow full exploration of Ignus’ lakes and rivers.

[b][u]Bows/Archer Magic[/u][/b] - A class of bow-based weapons and spells.

[b][u]Various Improvements[/u][/b] - The ability to upgrade structure pieces, corpse markers for maps, visual effect upgrades, and much more.

[b][u]More Content[/u][/b] - More creatures, spells, armors, structure pieces, and weapons.

Check it out here: https://trello.com/b/McOUEdRk/citadel-forged-with-fire-early-access-idea-board

Each tag has a “Vote” option, which you can use to express your interest in that particular feature:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0c9ed06374946f849617694c7db4d446fd6350e1.png[/img]

[b](Please note that not every feature on this board is guaranteed to make it into the game, nor is there any guarantee that the most voted for items will be worked on next. We prioritize things based on a combination of community enthusiasm and available developer resources)[/b]

Below is a simple breakdown of some of the things on the board. Please feel free to let us know which ones really excite you (the best way being via the vote function), or share new ideas of your own. We’ll be listening and adding things periodically!


[h1]Idea Board Content[/h1]

[b][u]Bug Fixes & Performance Optimization[/u][/b] - Improving optimization and fixing bugs will be an ongoing top priority for us during all phases of the Early Access process.

[b][u]Mod Support/Custom Map Support[/u][/b] - We’d like to allow players the freedom to create their own mods, maps and game modes, and enable them to share their creations via Steam Workshop.

[b][u]World Bosses[/u][/b] - Large, powerful end-game threats that can only be challenged by groups of players at extremely high levels. 

[b][u]World Events[/u][/b] - Randomly occurring events in the game world, like dangerous enemies and  valuable treasures spawning in broadcasted areas, that prompt player action.

[b][u]Broomstick League[/u][/b] - A competitive broomstick-based sporting diversion players can use to challenge each other in a fun, lighthearted way.

[b][u]Dueling System[/u][/b] - A system where two players could consensually agree to a friendly duel. Rather than fight to the death, they would fight until one person is reduced to a minimum amount of HP. 

[b][u]PVP Hotspots[/u][/b] - Nodes, towers, arenas or any other system to create areas on the map that make PVP fighting more attractive.

[b][u]Player Made Quests[/u][/b] - A system whereby players could create their own quests for other players to complete.

[b][u]Player/House Reputation System[/u][/b] - A system to track players who engage in frequent PKing. At a certain point they may receive some kind of mark and increased visibility.

[b][u]Improved Raiding Dynamic[/u][/b] - We’d like to improve raiding by making structures vulnerable only to specific siege spells. These spells can only be cast with the possession of a difficult to acquire item.

[b][u]Dynamic Weather System[/u][/b] - The possibility of interesting weather conditions dynamically occurring in the game world, with potential implications on gameplay.

[b][u]NPC Stores[/u][/b] - NPC stores in the three starter towns where players can buy and sell gear they’ve crafted or looted.

[b][u]Trading System[/u][/b] - A centralized place in-game where players can list items and sell them to other players asynchronously.

[b][u]Dye System[/u][/b] - A system whereby players can dye their armor/clothing different colors for an added level of appearance customizability. 

[b][u]Creature Possession[/u][/b] - The ability to use a spell to possess a tamed creature and directly control them for a short period of time.

[b][u]Cooking[/u][/b] - Use natural ingredients from the world to cook a variety of dishes. Cooked meals will provide time-limited buffs when consumed.

[b][u]Underwater Overhaul[/u][/b] - We’d love to add more creatures and points of interests to our underwater areas, and add items that allow full exploration of Ignus’ lakes and rivers.

[b][u]Bows/Archer Magic[/u][/b] - A class of bow-based weapons and spells.

[b][u]Various Improvements[/u][/b] - The ability to upgrade structure pieces, corpse markers for maps, visual effect upgrades, and much more.

[b][u]More Content[/u][/b] - More creatures, spells, armors, structure pieces, and weapons.

notes.title: Hotfix - 8/3/2017 - Crash on Load
notes.content:
We have reproduced and fixed a major issue which would cause some players, many of whom were using AMD hardware, to crash while trying to load into the game (usually at about 95% loaded). This issue was identified and reproduced on our AMD machine, but was likely also affecting some players with NVIDIA hardware too.

We've managed to reliably stop this from reproducing on our end and wanted to get the patch out to everyone ASAP. Please let us know if you continue to have issues and share with us your crash logs so we can diagnose and fix the problem.

Be sure to let your client update and give the official servers a moment to come back online with the latest build.

Thank you for your patience, and we hope to see you in-game!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/2/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/114766d7a08cf33134a5d9c990456378d1b47e7b.png[/img]

Our first big patch is now live! We've got three new creatures, a ton of bug fixes, performance optimizations and even some balance changes. Here's the nitty gritty what you can expect after you've updated and the servers return:

[h1]Creatures[/h1][list]
[*]Added Infernal Dragon
[*]Added Skeleton Warriors
[*]Added Wild Boar
[*]Fixed specific instance where NPCs would not attack[/list]

[h1]Spells[/h1][list]
[*]Telekinesis will no longer work on PVE servers
[*]Telekinesis will no longer work on throned structures
[*]Many spells now have a maximum range
[*]Weapon swapping no longer removes spell cooldowns[/list]

[h1]Structures[/h1][list]
[*]Structure downloading is now significantly faster
[*]Attack towers will now attack players
[*]All structure pieces will get one-time full heal to make up for the new max HP
[*]Fixed ability to heal own structures
[*]Chests on PVE servers are now only accessible by owners, party members and house members[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1][list]
[*]Custom distance culler implemented to greatly improve populated server performance
[*]Mouse sensitivity added to game options
[*]Decay rates can be custom-set on private servers
[*]Elixir of Amnesia works properly on servers with XP multipliers
[*]Progressing from level 58 to 59 no longer erroneously costs 9 million XP[/list]
